stories.title: Dan Flavin：灯管怎样改变一个房间
stories.titleEn: How Dan Flavin’s Fluorescent Tubes Change a Room
stories.zhDeck: 在 Dan Flavin 1966 年的作品《greens crossing greens》中，绿色灯管交叉排列，光线延伸到周围空间。11 月 11 日，毕尔巴鄂古根海姆美术馆将以《Some Light》回看 Dan Flavin 从 1960 年代到 1980 年代的灯光作品。馆方公布的《greens crossing greens》（1966）不是挂在墙上的一幅图：灯具本身划出一道边界，光则继续越过边界，扩散到房间里。展览预计持续至 2027 年 4 月 4 日，作品来自古根海姆收藏，并有 Dia Art Foundation 的借展。 [展览页面](https://www.guggenheim-bilbao.eus/en/exhibitions/dan-flavin) · [HENI 报道](https://heni.com/news/article/guggenheim-museum-bilbao-to-open-dan-flavin-survey-in-november-2026)
stories.enDeck: A Guggenheim Bilbao exhibition returns to the artist’s work in light.
stories.zhMarkdown:
在 Dan Flavin 1966 年的作品《greens crossing greens》中，绿色灯管交叉排列，光线延伸到周围空间。11 月 11 日，毕尔巴鄂古根海姆美术馆将以《Some Light》回看 Dan Flavin 从 1960 年代到 1980 年代的灯光作品。馆方公布的《greens crossing greens》（1966）不是挂在墙上的一幅图：灯具本身划出一道边界，光则继续越过边界，扩散到房间里。展览预计持续至 2027 年 4 月 4 日，作品来自古根海姆收藏，并有 Dia Art Foundation 的借展。 [展览页面](https://www.guggenheim-bilbao.eus/en/exhibitions/dan-flavin) · [HENI 报道](https://heni.com/news/article/guggenheim-museum-bilbao-to-open-dan-flavin-survey-in-november-2026)

Flavin 使用的是工业生产的荧光灯，而不是为艺术特制的一种光。MIT List 对一件馆藏作品的介绍写到，他在纽约美国自然历史博物馆做保安时，开始画以电光为元素的雕塑草图。1963 年的实验后来成为持续三十余年的工作：颜色和长度来自有限的现成选项，变化来自它们如何被排列，以及光如何碰到墙、地面和身体。 [MIT List](https://listart.mit.edu/art-artists/untitled-conor-cruise-obrien-5c-1990) · [展览页面](https://www.guggenheim-bilbao.eus/en/exhibitions/dan-flavin)

限制不是这套方法的缺点，反而是观看的入口。1963 年的《the nominal three》把灯管按一、一组二、一组三的节奏沿墙排开。西班牙索菲亚王后艺术中心对自己所藏版本的说明，把这组数字与作品所致敬的哲学家威廉·奥卡姆联系起来；Judd Foundation 则记录，Flavin 后来考虑在这一数列中加入第四组，但那一方案没有被做成立体作品。不同机构收藏的是不同版本，这些资料提供作品的背景，不代表每个版本都出现在毕尔巴鄂。 [Reina Sofía](https://www.museoreinasofia.es/en/collections/artwork/nominal-three-william-ockham/) · [Judd Foundation](https://juddfoundation.org/index-of-works/extension-of-nominal-3-to-william-ockham-1964/)

从墙面走向房间，作品也开始改变人的路线。毕尔巴鄂展览介绍把 Flavin 的结构分为角落、纪念碑、屏障与走廊；David Zwirner 画廊对另一场旧展的研究解释，屏障作品可以限制人进入某个空间，却让光继续穿过。灯管因此既是物件，也是对建筑边界的一次重新安排。画廊的解读来自其展览资料，不是对这次毕尔巴鄂现场的实测。 [展览页面](https://www.guggenheim-bilbao.eus/en/exhibitions/dan-flavin) · [David Zwirner](https://www.davidzwirner.com/exhibitions/2021/exceptional-works-dan-flavin)

这些作品并不总是冷冰冰的几何练习。芝加哥当代艺术博物馆在一场历史回顾展中，把献给亲友、艺术家的灯光作品与带有政治意味的作品并置；Pulitzer Arts Foundation 回看 Tiffany Bell 策划的 2008 年展览时则记录，作品在白天和夜晚与建筑形成不同的光感；展览还打开了平时不对公众开放的走廊。这些材料提醒我们：作品既关乎艺术家选择把它献给谁，也关乎它在哪里、何时被看见。 [MCA Chicago](https://mcachicago.org/whats-on/exhibitions/dan-flavin-a-retrospective/) · [Pulitzer Arts Foundation](https://pulitzerarts.org/art/dan-flavin-constructed-light/)

献给 Vladimir Tatlin 的“纪念碑”系列尤其能说明这种转换。史密森尼 Hirshhorn 的无障碍导览描述，馆藏的一个 1967 年版本由五根竖直灯管组成，看上去像一座塔；毕尔巴鄂馆方则列出了由 Dia 借来的系列作品。两件作品来自同一系列，但不是同一件，不能用一处的画面代替另一处的现场。 [Hirshhorn](https://hirshhorn.si.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Big-Things-for-Big-Rooms-Access-Brochure.pdf) · [展览页面](https://www.guggenheim-bilbao.eus/en/exhibitions/dan-flavin)

灯管是日用品，也会损坏、停产。耶鲁大学艺术馆保存人员在 2024 年说明，为维护馆藏的两件 Flavin 作品，他们寻找旧灯管，也与艺术家工作室合作寻找重制的特定颜色灯管，并评估更新原有布线。这不是毕尔巴鄂展览的维护说明，却提醒我们：一件看上去轻盈的光作品，背后依靠的是持续的技术与保存工作。 [耶鲁大学艺术馆保存研究](https://artgallery.yale.edu/sites/default/files/2024-09/Gallery_Fall_2024_Magazine_0.pdf)

ArtsLife 评论者 Massimo Mattioli 提出了不同的观看感受：作品排列密集时，各组灯光可能彼此干扰，让单件作品与空间的关系变弱。这是他的评论，观众也可能有不同体验。[ArtsLife](https://artslife.com/2026/11/10/tanti-flavin-nessun-flavin-limpossibile-mostra-del-guggenheim-di-bilbao/)

今天重看 Flavin，有意思的不是把一根灯管称为艺术的姿态，而是他让人留意一件日常物如何决定空间：走到哪里会被挡住，墙角怎样改变颜色，身体怎样进入光里。展览将怎样利用毕尔巴鄂的具体空间，还要等观众实际走进去之后再看。
stories.enMarkdown:
In Dan Flavin’s 1966 work *greens crossing greens*, green fluorescent tubes intersect and cast their light into the surrounding space. On November 11, the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao is due to open *Some Light*, a survey of Dan Flavin’s works from the 1960s through the 1980s. The museum’s *greens crossing greens* (1966) is more than an image on a wall: its fixtures define a boundary while the light spreads beyond it. The show runs through April 4, 2027, drawing on Guggenheim holdings and loans from the Dia Art Foundation. [Museum](https://www.guggenheim-bilbao.eus/en/exhibitions/dan-flavin) · [HENI](https://heni.com/news/article/guggenheim-museum-bilbao-to-open-dan-flavin-survey-in-november-2026)

Flavin worked with commercially manufactured fluorescent lamps rather than a special artistic light. MIT List’s account of a work in its collection records him beginning sketches for sculptures using electric light while working as a guard at New York’s American Museum of Natural History. Experiments in 1963 developed into a practice lasting more than three decades. His palette and lamp lengths came from a limited industrial range; the variations emerged through placement and through the way light met walls, floors and people. [MIT List](https://listart.mit.edu/art-artists/untitled-conor-cruise-obrien-5c-1990) · [Museum](https://www.guggenheim-bilbao.eus/en/exhibitions/dan-flavin)

The limits are also a way into the work. In *the nominal three* (1963), groups of one, two and three tubes establish a rhythm across a wall. The Reina Sofía’s account of its own edition connects the sequence to the philosopher William of Ockham, to whom the work is dedicated. The Judd Foundation records that Flavin later considered a fourth grouping, though that proposal was never realised in three dimensions. These institutional records concern different editions and drawings; they should not be mistaken for an inventory of the Bilbao show. [Reina Sofía](https://www.museoreinasofia.es/en/collections/artwork/nominal-three-william-ockham/) · [Judd Foundation](https://juddfoundation.org/index-of-works/extension-of-nominal-3-to-william-ockham-1964/)

As the work moves from wall to room, it changes the visitor’s route. The Bilbao museum describes a vocabulary of corners, monuments, barriers and corridors. In material for an earlier exhibition, David Zwirner explains how a barrier can limit access to a space while light continues through it. A fixture is therefore both an object and a way of reorganising architecture. That gallery account is context from an earlier show, not a first-hand description of the present installation. [Museum](https://www.guggenheim-bilbao.eus/en/exhibitions/dan-flavin) · [David Zwirner](https://www.davidzwirner.com/exhibitions/2021/exceptional-works-dan-flavin)

These works are not simply cool geometric exercises. A historical retrospective at MCA Chicago placed works dedicated to friends and fellow artists alongside works with political dimensions. The Pulitzer Arts Foundation’s account of its 2008 exhibition, curated by Tiffany Bell, describes light changing with the time of day and works extending into corridors usually closed to visitors. The accounts attend both to the people named in the works and to where and when they are seen. [MCA Chicago](https://mcachicago.org/whats-on/exhibitions/dan-flavin-a-retrospective/) · [Pulitzer Arts Foundation](https://pulitzerarts.org/art/dan-flavin-constructed-light/)

The “monuments” for Vladimir Tatlin show the conversion at work. An accessibility guide at the Smithsonian’s Hirshhorn describes a 1967 version made of five vertical tubes, suggesting the shape of a tower. Bilbao lists another work from the series on loan from Dia. They are related works, not the same object; a photograph of one should not be presented as documentation of the other. [Hirshhorn](https://hirshhorn.si.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Big-Things-for-Big-Rooms-Access-Brochure.pdf) · [Museum](https://www.guggenheim-bilbao.eus/en/exhibitions/dan-flavin)

Ordinary lamps also break and become obsolete. In 2024, conservators at the Yale University Art Gallery described sourcing vintage lamps for two Flavin works and working with the artist’s studio to obtain remade tubes with particular colors, while assessing the original wiring. This is not a conservation report for Bilbao, but it shows that the apparent lightness of these works depends on continuing technical care. [Yale conservation article](https://artgallery.yale.edu/sites/default/files/2024-09/Gallery_Fall_2024_Magazine_0.pdf)

ArtsLife critic Massimo Mattioli offers a different response: when works are placed close together, their lights may interfere with one another and weaken each piece’s relationship with the room. This is his critical view; visitors may respond differently. [ArtsLife](https://artslife.com/2026/11/10/tanti-flavin-nessun-flavin-limpossibile-mostra-del-guggenheim-di-bilbao/)

The interest in looking at Flavin now is not simply the gesture of calling a lamp art. It is the way an everyday object can determine a room: where movement stops, how a corner changes color, and how a body enters the light. What the works make of Bilbao’s particular spaces remains to be seen by visitors.

stories.title: Standing Ground：一件蕾丝礼服回到爱尔兰
stories.titleEn: Standing Ground: An Irish Lace Gown Returns to Dublin
stories.zhDeck: 爱尔兰的蕾丝织工做了一件礼服，最终下摆周长达到 13 米。它在巴黎高级定制周亮相之后，回到都柏林的爱尔兰国家博物馆。爱尔兰设计与工艺委员会公布的《Standing Ground: Ireland-France》展期从 11 月 11 日至 2027 年 1 月 10 日，展出这件 Carrickmacross 蕾丝礼服，以及一件由巴黎 Maison Vermont 绣制胸衣的裙装。[展览页面](https://www.dcci.ie/events/standing-ground-exhibition/) · [Irish Times 对织工的采访](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/fashion/2026/11/09/more-than-4300-hours-of-work-meet-the-carrickmacross-lacemakers-behind-irelands-most-exquisite-dress/)
stories.enDeck: A couture dress made with Carrickmacross lace is on display in Ireland.
stories.zhMarkdown:
爱尔兰的蕾丝织工做了一件礼服，最终下摆周长达到 13 米。它在巴黎高级定制周亮相之后，回到都柏林的爱尔兰国家博物馆。爱尔兰设计与工艺委员会公布的《Standing Ground: Ireland-France》展期从 11 月 11 日至 2027 年 1 月 10 日，展出这件 Carrickmacross 蕾丝礼服，以及一件由巴黎 Maison Vermont 绣制胸衣的裙装。[展览页面](https://www.dcci.ie/events/standing-ground-exhibition/) · [Irish Times 对织工的采访](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/fashion/2026/11/09/more-than-4300-hours-of-work-meet-the-carrickmacross-lacemakers-behind-irelands-most-exquisite-dress/)

这不是一件单靠设计师名字完成的衣服。爱尔兰设计师 Michael Stewart 为蕾丝绘制了荆棘、黑莓和蜻蜓等图案；主办方称，蒙纳汉郡的工匠以手工完成制作。《Irish Times》走访织工后记录，礼服耗时超过 4,300 小时；13 米下摆的计算不包括插片和拖尾。[展览页面](https://www.dcci.ie/events/standing-ground-exhibition/) · [织工采访](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/fashion/2026/11/09/more-than-4300-hours-of-work-meet-the-carrickmacross-lacemakers-behind-irelands-most-exquisite-dress/)

Carrickmacross 蕾丝起源于 19 世纪初的爱尔兰。阿尔斯特民俗博物馆的资料介绍，这种贴花技法使用网底，将布料固定、沿图案勾线，再剪去多余部分，辅以填充针法。它过去也为乡村女性提供收入；展览让观众看到的，不只是细密的花纹，还有需要共同完成它的手和时间。[Ulster Folk Museum](https://www.ulsterfolkmuseum.org/stories/lacemaking) · [展览页面](https://www.dcci.ie/events/standing-ground-exhibition/)

这次合作有一条很具体的来路。设计师兼教育者 Natalie B. Coleman 曾向 Stewart 展示由 Martha Hughes 制作的蕾丝婚纱；《Irish Times》记录，她后来参与协调设计师与织工的合作。2026 年 7 月，模特 Kristen McMenamy 穿着成衣为 Standing Ground 的巴黎首场高定秀收尾。《W Magazine》报道，参与这件礼服制作的有 26 位织工。[Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/fashion/2026/11/09/more-than-4300-hours-of-work-meet-the-carrickmacross-lacemakers-behind-irelands-most-exquisite-dress/) · [W Magazine](https://www.wmagazine.com/fashion/standing-ground-couture-fall-2026-photos)

展出的另一件衣服把协作带向法国刺绣。Standing Ground 在 2024 年获得首届 LVMH Savoir-Faire Prize；奖项主办方当时公布，支持包括奖金、导师指导，以及与 Maison Vermont 的刺绣合作。DCCI 介绍，展览中的另一条裙装正是由该工坊制作胸衣装饰。[LVMH](https://www.lvmh.com/en/news-lvmh/2024-lvmh-prize-for-young-fashion-designers-11th-edition--the-winners/) · [展览页面](https://www.dcci.ie/events/standing-ground-exhibition/)

Stewart 的身体轮廓来自另一套长期练习。《British Vogue》在首秀前采访他时，记录了工作室里的定制服制作；《Harper’s Bazaar》和《10 Magazine》对现场的报道则注意到他将珠子包进面料，使表面形成连续的线条。巴黎秀场的观察帮助理解这次展品的制作背景，但不能替代对都柏林展陈的现场判断。[British Vogue](https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/michael-stewart-standing-ground-couture-interview) · [Harper’s Bazaar](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/fashion/a71843572/paris-fall-2026-couture-fashion-week-standing-ground/) · [10 Magazine](https://10magazine.com/standing-ground-couture-aw26/)

《i-D》在秀后采访中记录，Stewart 把奖项资源投入打版、重新裁剪与样衣；《Wallpaper*》从巴黎现场观察到修身长裙与珠饰结构。不同报道共同指向一个有意思的地方：高级定制的价值不只落在最后的秀场几分钟，也包括工坊之间怎样传递、调整和保存一项技术。[i-D](https://i-d.co/article/standing-ground-couture/) · [Wallpaper*](https://www.wallpaper.com/fashion-beauty/haute-couture-week-aw-2026-best-shows)

这场展览把从蒙纳汉到巴黎的过程带回爱尔兰。它让一件衣服重新和那些制作它的人相遇；至于这种合作能否给更多年轻织工带来持续的工作机会，还需要看展览之后发生什么。

《British Vogue》另一篇对织工的实地采访追溯了这项技艺的劳动处境：Anne McMahon 回忆，自己 14 岁开始为修会制作蕾丝，家庭缝纫收入曾用来支付额外开支。报道也提到现今老一代织工向学习者传授技艺。这些人的经验让礼服背后的工艺传承有了具体面孔；报道对 Tourism Ireland 的协助表示感谢，阅读时也应了解这一关系。[British Vogue 织工采访](https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/standing-ground-carrickmacross-lace-couture-dress)
stories.enMarkdown:
An Irish lace-making team has made a gown with a 13-metre hem. After its appearance at Paris Haute Couture Week, the dress returns to Dublin’s National Museum of Ireland. The Design & Crafts Council Ireland lists *Standing Ground: Ireland-France* from November 11 through January 10, 2027, showing the Carrickmacross lace gown alongside a dress with a bodice embroidered by Paris atelier Maison Vermont. [Exhibition](https://www.dcci.ie/events/standing-ground-exhibition/) · [Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/fashion/2026/11/09/more-than-4300-hours-of-work-meet-the-carrickmacross-lacemakers-behind-irelands-most-exquisite-dress/)

This is not a garment made by a designer’s name alone. Irish designer Michael Stewart drew motifs including brambles, blackberries and dragonflies; the organiser says artisans in County Monaghan made the lace by hand. Reporting from the makers, *The Irish Times* records more than 4,300 hours of work. Its 13-metre hem measurement excludes the godet and train. [Exhibition](https://www.dcci.ie/events/standing-ground-exhibition/) · [Lacemakers](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/fashion/2026/11/09/more-than-4300-hours-of-work-meet-the-carrickmacross-lacemakers-behind-irelands-most-exquisite-dress/)

Carrickmacross lace emerged in early nineteenth-century Ireland. The Ulster Folk Museum describes an appliqué technique in which fabric is secured over net, outlined and cut away, then enhanced with filling stitches. It also offered rural women an income. The exhibition makes visible not only a delicate pattern but the people and time needed to make it together. [Ulster Folk Museum](https://www.ulsterfolkmuseum.org/stories/lacemaking) · [Exhibition](https://www.dcci.ie/events/standing-ground-exhibition/)

This collaboration has a specific origin. Designer and educator Natalie B. Coleman showed Stewart her own lace wedding dress made by Martha Hughes; *The Irish Times* reports that she later helped connect the designer and the lacemakers. In July 2026, model Kristen McMenamy wore the finished gown to close Standing Ground’s first Paris couture show. *W Magazine* reports that 26 lacemakers worked on it. [Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/life-style/fashion/2026/11/09/more-than-4300-hours-of-work-meet-the-carrickmacross-lacemakers-behind-irelands-most-exquisite-dress/) · [W Magazine](https://www.wmagazine.com/fashion/standing-ground-couture-fall-2026-photos)

The second garment takes the collaboration toward French embroidery. Standing Ground won the inaugural LVMH Savoir-Faire Prize in 2024; the prize organiser described financial support, mentoring and a collaboration with Maison Vermont. DCCI says the Paris atelier embroidered the bodice of the other dress in the exhibition. [LVMH](https://www.lvmh.com/en/news-lvmh/2024-lvmh-prize-for-young-fashion-designers-11th-edition--the-winners/) · [Exhibition](https://www.dcci.ie/events/standing-ground-exhibition/)

Stewart’s silhouettes grow from a longer practice. *British Vogue* interviewed him in his London studio before the couture debut and described his custom-order work. At the show, *Harper’s Bazaar* and *10 Magazine* noticed beads enclosed in fabric to form continuous lines. These observations help explain the garments’ background; they are not first-hand accounts of the Dublin installation. [British Vogue](https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/michael-stewart-standing-ground-couture-interview) · [Harper’s Bazaar](https://www.harpersbazaar.com/fashion/a71843572/paris-fall-2026-couture-fashion-week-standing-ground/) · [10 Magazine](https://10magazine.com/standing-ground-couture-aw26/)

In a post-show interview with *i-D*, Stewart described putting resources into pattern cutting and prototypes. Reporting from Paris, *Wallpaper* observed the fitted dresses and embedded beadwork. Together they suggest that couture’s value includes more than a few minutes on a runway: it also lies in how workshops pass on, adapt and preserve a technique. [i-D](https://i-d.co/article/standing-ground-couture/) · [Wallpaper](https://www.wallpaper.com/fashion-beauty/haute-couture-week-aw-2026-best-shows)

The exhibition brings the journey from Monaghan to Paris back to Ireland, reconnecting a garment with the people who made it. Whether such collaborations can create sustained work for younger lacemakers is a question that extends beyond the show.
A separate *British Vogue* visit to the lacemakers traces the labour behind the technique. Anne McMahon recalled beginning to sew for a convent at 14, and how her mother’s sewing helped pay for household extras. The report also describes an older maker teaching the craft to new learners. These accounts give specific people to the question of transmission; the article acknowledges assistance from Tourism Ireland, a relationship readers should know. [British Vogue lacemakers report](https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/standing-ground-carrickmacross-lace-couture-dress)

stories.title: 2hollis 的新专辑，让天野喜孝画出他的角色
stories.titleEn: 2hollis Invites Yoshitaka Amano to Draw His Character
stories.zhDeck: 2hollis 的世界里，人物形象和音乐一直一起生长。11 月 11 日，环球音乐日本发布了新专辑《Pirouette》的发行消息；封面则交给日本艺术家天野喜孝手绘。对熟悉《最终幻想》视觉的人来说，封面上的人物并不是把游戏角色贴到一张流行唱片上，而是让这位音乐人进入画家已有的形象语言。天野自己的说明强调，他觉得 2hollis 的气质与自己长期描绘的人物相近，因此不必为了这次合作调整画风。[环球音乐日本](https://www.universal-music.co.jp/2hollis/news/2026-11-11/) · [天野喜孝官方说明](https://www.yoshitakaamanoinc.com/post/yoshitaka-amano-x-2hollis-new-album-pirouette)
stories.enDeck: The artist created the cover of the musician’s album Pirouette.
stories.zhMarkdown:
2hollis 的世界里，人物形象和音乐一直一起生长。11 月 11 日，环球音乐日本发布了新专辑《Pirouette》的发行消息；封面则交给日本艺术家天野喜孝手绘。对熟悉《最终幻想》视觉的人来说，封面上的人物并不是把游戏角色贴到一张流行唱片上，而是让这位音乐人进入画家已有的形象语言。天野自己的说明强调，他觉得 2hollis 的气质与自己长期描绘的人物相近，因此不必为了这次合作调整画风。[环球音乐日本](https://www.universal-music.co.jp/2hollis/news/2026-11-11/) · [天野喜孝官方说明](https://www.yoshitakaamanoinc.com/post/yoshitaka-amano-x-2hollis-new-album-pirouette)

这也是唱片公司讲述《Pirouette》的方式。环球音乐加拿大在公布时把它描述为 2hollis 较浪漫、表达更直接的一个阶段；《Complex》列出了 16 首曲目和此前已公开的《Hurt》《Sex》《Warhorse》。这些信息说明了新专辑的公开框架，但截至本次核查，还没有独立核验每个地区的完整上架状态，因此不宜把地区差异写成全球同步发行。[环球音乐加拿大](https://www.universalmusic.ca/2026/09/22/2hollis-announces-new-album-pirouette-releasing-november-11th/) · [Complex](https://www.complex.com/music/a/dimassanfiorenzo/2hollis-new-album-pirouette-tracklist-features-producers)

这张封面之所以贴合他的工作方式，是因为 2hollis 本来就把视觉当作音乐的一部分。在首尔接受 Weverse Magazine 采访时，他谈到自己对世界构建的兴趣，希望听众走入的不止是一首歌，而是一整套有声音与形象的环境；他也说，现场演出改变了他对作品的想象。在 Dazed 与 Arca 的对话里，他把网络称作塑造自己、又让人复杂依赖的成长环境。这些都是他的自述，不是对所有听众如何接收作品的结论。[Weverse Magazine](https://magazine.weverse.io/article/view/1591?lang=en) · [Dazed](https://origin.dazeddigital.com/music/article/69802/1/2hollis-arca-in-conversation-dazed-spring-2026-issue) 在 2025 年接受 Office Magazine 采访时，他曾说自己创作音乐时总会视觉化思考，并把不同专辑想成同一个概念世界的一部分。[Office Magazine](https://officemagazine.net/2hollis-chasing-sunlight)

先行曲也留下了可以比较的入口。Dork 报道《Hurt》的影像由他自己执导和剪辑；《哈佛深红报》评论《Warhorse》时留意到失真合成器、重低音和变化的人声，同时认为其歌词的跳跃未必总形成连贯叙事。Melodic Magazine 的作者则特别留意到歌曲末尾的钢琴转折。这些评价并不相同，但都指向一件事：他的作品允许声音的冲击与情绪的不确定并存。[Dork](https://readdork.com/news/2hollis-hurt-new-single-video) · [Harvard Crimson](https://www.thecrimson.com/article/2026/10/6/2hollis-warhorse-review/) · [Melodic](https://www.melodicmag.com/news/new-music/2hollis-proves-warhorse-is-everything-fans-have-been-waiting-for-and-more/)

回看上一张《star》，Pitchfork 注意到他把更亲密的情绪放进更大的电子声音里；早在《boy》时期，Interview Magazine 的巡演采访已记录他如何在网络作品之外面对真实观众。《Pirouette》的封面因此不是一张孤立的漂亮图片：它把长期经营的音乐身份，交给另一位有鲜明世界观的创作者重新描绘。至于这张新专辑本身能否把这种视觉承诺延续到每首歌，还需要听过完整作品再判断。[Pitchfork《star》评论](https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/2hollis-star/) · [Interview Magazine](https://www.interviewmagazine.com/music/a-mob-of-kids-trapped-me-on-the-road-with-2hollis) · [Pitchfork 新专辑报道](https://pitchfork.com/story/2hollis-announces-new-album-pirouette/)
stories.enMarkdown:
In 2hollis’s work, image and music have long grown together. On November 11, Universal Music Japan announced the release of his new album *Pirouette*, whose cover was hand-drawn by Japanese artist Yoshitaka Amano. For anyone familiar with the visual language of *Final Fantasy*, this is more than a game character placed on a pop record: it brings the musician into a world the illustrator has been building for decades. Amano’s own account says he saw a sensitivity in 2hollis that felt close to the characters he had long drawn, so he did not need to change his style for the collaboration. [Universal Music Japan](https://www.universal-music.co.jp/2hollis/news/2026-11-11/) · [Amano’s account](https://www.yoshitakaamanoinc.com/post/yoshitaka-amano-x-2hollis-new-album-pirouette)

The label frames *Pirouette* as a more romantic and expressive phase. *Complex* lists 16 tracks, including the previously released “Hurt,” “Sex” and “Warhorse.” That establishes the public outline, though availability in every territory has not been independently checked; it should not be described as a simultaneous worldwide release. [Universal Music Canada](https://www.universalmusic.ca/2026/09/22/2hollis-announces-new-album-pirouette-releasing-november-11th/) · [Complex](https://www.complex.com/music/a/dimassanfiorenzo/2hollis-new-album-pirouette-tracklist-features-producers)

The cover fits an artist who treats visuals as part of music. In an interview in Seoul, 2hollis told Weverse Magazine that he wanted listeners to enter an entire world rather than encounter one song in isolation. Performing live, he said, had also changed the way he imagined his work. In a Dazed conversation with Arca, he described the internet as an environment that formed him and that he related to in complicated ways. These are his own accounts, not proof of how every listener receives the music. [Weverse Magazine](https://magazine.weverse.io/article/view/1591?lang=en) · [Dazed](https://origin.dazeddigital.com/music/article/69802/1/2hollis-arca-in-conversation-dazed-spring-2026-issue) In a 2025 Office Magazine interview, he said he thinks visually while making music and imagines his albums as part of the same conceptual world. [Office Magazine](https://officemagazine.net/2hollis-chasing-sunlight)

The earlier singles offer points of comparison. Dork reported that 2hollis directed and edited the “Hurt” video himself. Reviewing “Warhorse,” the Harvard Crimson noticed distorted synthesizers, heavy bass and shifting vocals, while questioning whether its jumping images always form a coherent story. A Melodic Magazine writer singled out the piano turn at the end. Their responses differ, but each points to a place where sonic impact and emotional uncertainty coexist. [Dork](https://readdork.com/news/2hollis-hurt-new-single-video) · [Harvard Crimson](https://www.thecrimson.com/article/2026/10/6/2hollis-warhorse-review/) · [Melodic](https://www.melodicmag.com/news/new-music/2hollis-proves-warhorse-is-everything-fans-have-been-waiting-for-and-more/)

Reviewing *star*, Pitchfork heard intimate feelings within a larger electronic sound. An earlier Interview Magazine conversation on the *boy* tour had already documented how he faced audiences beyond his online work. The *Pirouette* cover is therefore not an isolated beautiful picture: it lets another artist with a strong visual world redraw an identity 2hollis has built over time. Whether the album itself carries that visual promise through every track is a judgment to make after hearing the complete work. [Pitchfork on *star*](https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/2hollis-star/) · [Interview Magazine](https://www.interviewmagazine.com/music/a-mob-of-kids-trapped-me-on-the-road-with-2hollis) · [Pitchfork on the announcement](https://pitchfork.com/story/2hollis-announces-new-album-pirouette/)

stories.title: 《Avedon》把时尚摄影师的镜头转回他自己
stories.titleEn: Avedon Turns the Camera Toward the Photographer
stories.zhDeck: Richard Avedon 拍过时装模特、政客、矿工和流浪者。Ron Howard 的纪录片《Avedon》把镜头转向这位摄影师：影片曾于今年戛纳电影节特别展映，Netflix 宣布 11 月 11 日上线。影片由 Imagine Documentaries、Fifth Season 与 Richard Avedon Foundation 合作，使用档案照片、幕后影像和受访者的回忆。这里说的是平台公布的上线日期，不代表每个地区此刻都已可以播放。[Netflix](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/avedon-release-date-news?inapp=true-65) · [戛纳电影节](https://www.festival-cannes.com/en/2026/avedon-ron-howard-explores-the-career-of-the-photographic-genius/)
stories.enDeck: Ron Howard’s documentary considers the life and images of Richard Avedon.
stories.zhMarkdown:
Richard Avedon 拍过时装模特、政客、矿工和流浪者。Ron Howard 的纪录片《Avedon》把镜头转向这位摄影师：影片曾于今年戛纳电影节特别展映，Netflix 宣布 11 月 11 日上线。影片由 Imagine Documentaries、Fifth Season 与 Richard Avedon Foundation 合作，使用档案照片、幕后影像和受访者的回忆。这里说的是平台公布的上线日期，不代表每个地区此刻都已可以播放。[Netflix](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/avedon-release-date-news?inapp=true-65) · [戛纳电影节](https://www.festival-cannes.com/en/2026/avedon-ron-howard-explores-the-career-of-the-photographic-genius/)

Howard 在 Netflix 发布的文章中说，制作时面临的选择并不只是“哪张照片最有名”：还有多少时间应该留给较难观看、却能提示摄影师内心问题的作品。他在戛纳接受采访时进一步说明，照片数量足以支撑更长的系列，因此他优先选择能具体指向 Avedon 本人的材料。庞大的档案并不会自动成为一部影片；剪辑如何取舍，本身就是这部肖像的观点。[Howard 的文章](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/ron-howard-on-avedon) · [戛纳访谈](https://www.festival-cannes.com/en/2026/avedon-ron-howard-explores-the-career-of-the-photographic-genius/)

这种选择也让摄影师的两种工作并置。在 Vanity Fair 的采访里，Howard 说他最初熟悉的是 Avedon 的名人和商业摄影，后来才更重视他使用名声与资源讲述其他人的故事。SFMOMA 早年的回顾展把战后时装、反主流文化、权力人物与普通人的肖像放在同一条职业轨迹中；与 James Baldwin 合作的 1964 年《Nothing Personal》，则把摄影与文字并置。Avedon Foundation 的书目确认了这项合作的基本信息。[Vanity Fair](https://www.vanityfair.com/photos/ron-howard-richard-avedon-documentary) · [SFMOMA](https://www.sfmoma.org/press/release/sfmoma-presents-richard-avedon-photographs-194620/) · [Avedon Foundation](https://www.avedonfoundation.org/nothing-personal-1964-essay-by-james-baldwin)

《In the American West》是这条轨迹上的一个具体转折。委托项目的 Amon Carter Museum 记载，Avedon 在 1979 至 1984 年间走访多个州，拍摄了 752 次，并从大量底片中形成 124 幅作品；Sheldon Museum 也介绍了他如何把流动的白色背景带到矿区、牧场等地方。白色背景让观众更难依赖地点来判断面前的人，同时又不能让照片变成完全中立的记录。Henri Cartier-Bresson 基金会的展览文字则把这组白背景肖像与浪漫化的美国西部图景作了对照。[Amon Carter Museum](https://www.cartermuseum.org/carter-collection/collection-group/american-west) · [Sheldon Museum](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/avedon-in-the-american-west/) · [Henri Cartier-Bresson 基金会](https://www.henricartierbresson.org/en/expositions/richard-avedon/)

《卫报》采访了曾担任助手的 Sebastian Kim，记录拍摄者如何在偶然瞬间作出选择；Digital Camera World 的影评则认为这部与基金会合作的影片对摄影师某些个人争议着墨较谨慎。两种视角让这部纪录片值得被看成一次重新组织，而不是最终定论。时尚、政治和日常生活在 Avedon 的档案里彼此靠近：同一张白纸前，名人和普通人都必须面对摄影师的目光，而真正的问题是这束目光让我们看见了什么、又没有看见什么。[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2026/nov/10/richard-avedon-photography-netflix-documentary) · [Digital Camera World](https://www.digitalcameraworld.com/photography/portrait-photography/ron-howard-new-documentary-movie-avedon-reminds-us-why-the-greatest-photographer-of-the-20th-century-didnt-care-what-camera-he-used) · [AP 排期](https://abcnews.com/Technology/wireStory/stream-u2-misty-green-chosen-randy-travis-137966015)

The Art Newspaper 的影评人 Mark Asch 注意到，影片大量采用了 Helen Whitney 旧纪录片中的采访材料；他觉得新片有观看乐趣，也重复了部分熟悉的故事。[The Art Newspaper](https://www.theartnewspaper.com/2026/05/20/richard-avedon-documentary-ron-howard-cannes-film-festival)
stories.enMarkdown:
Richard Avedon photographed fashion models, politicians, miners and drifters. Ron Howard’s documentary *Avedon* turns the camera toward the photographer himself. The film screened as a special presentation at Cannes this year, and Netflix announced a November 11 release. Produced by Imagine Documentaries and Fifth Season in association with the Richard Avedon Foundation, it draws on archival photographs, behind-the-scenes footage and recollections from collaborators. This is the platform’s announced date; playback in every territory has not been checked. [Netflix](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/avedon-release-date-news?inapp=true-65) · [Festival de Cannes](https://www.festival-cannes.com/en/2026/avedon-ron-howard-explores-the-career-of-the-photographic-genius/)

In an essay published by Netflix, Howard said the edit was not simply a question of choosing the most famous photographs. He also had to decide how much time to give more difficult images that might reveal something about the photographer’s inner life. At Cannes, he explained that the archive could have supported a much longer series, so he leaned toward images that said something specific about Avedon himself. A large archive does not automatically make a film; the edit is already a point of view. [Howard’s essay](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/ron-howard-on-avedon) · [Cannes interview](https://www.festival-cannes.com/en/2026/avedon-ron-howard-explores-the-career-of-the-photographic-genius/)

That choice places different kinds of work beside one another. In Vanity Fair, Howard said he first knew Avedon through celebrity and commercial photography, before becoming more interested in how he used his position and resources to tell other people’s stories. An earlier SFMOMA retrospective placed postwar fashion, counterculture, power and ordinary lives on the same career trajectory. *Nothing Personal*, made with James Baldwin in 1964, placed photographs beside writing; the Avedon Foundation’s catalogue confirms the collaboration. [Vanity Fair](https://www.vanityfair.com/photos/ron-howard-richard-avedon-documentary) · [SFMOMA](https://www.sfmoma.org/press/release/sfmoma-presents-richard-avedon-photographs-194620/) · [Avedon Foundation](https://www.avedonfoundation.org/nothing-personal-1964-essay-by-james-baldwin)

*In the American West* offers a specific turning point. The Amon Carter Museum, which commissioned the project, records that Avedon travelled through multiple states between 1979 and 1984, conducted 752 sittings and produced a series of 124 photographs. The Sheldon Museum describes the portable white backdrop he brought to places including mining camps and ranches. That backdrop makes location less available as an easy judgment about the person in front of the lens, but it cannot make a photograph entirely neutral. The Fondation Henri Cartier-Bresson’s exhibition text contrasts these white-background portraits with romanticised images of the American West. [Amon Carter Museum](https://www.cartermuseum.org/carter-collection/collection-group/american-west) · [Sheldon Museum](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/avedon-in-the-american-west/) · [Fondation Henri Cartier-Bresson](https://www.henricartierbresson.org/en/expositions/richard-avedon/)

The Guardian spoke with former assistant Sebastian Kim about how Avedon made decisions in unexpected moments. Digital Camera World’s review, meanwhile, judged the film—made with the foundation’s cooperation—as cautious about some contested aspects of his private life. Together, those views suggest a documentary that reorganises a life rather than delivers a final verdict. Fashion, politics and daily life sit close together in Avedon’s archive. Before the same white paper, famous and ordinary people alike meet the photographer’s gaze; the question is what that gaze lets us see, and what it leaves outside the frame. [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2026/nov/10/richard-avedon-photography-netflix-documentary) · [Digital Camera World](https://www.digitalcameraworld.com/photography/portrait-photography/ron-howard-new-documentary-movie-avedon-reminds-us-why-the-greatest-photographer-of-the-20th-century-didnt-care-what-camera-he-used) · [AP schedule](https://abcnews.com/Technology/wireStory/stream-u2-misty-green-chosen-randy-travis-137966015)


The Art Newspaper critic Mark Asch notes that the film draws extensively on interviews from Helen Whitney’s earlier documentary; he found it engaging but also saw familiar anecdotes revisited. [The Art Newspaper](https://www.theartnewspaper.com/2026/05/20/richard-avedon-documentary-ron-howard-cannes-film-festival)

stories.zhDeck: 一双工作鞋进入时装合作时，保护功能会不会先被拿掉？ASICS WORKING 与 FreshService 的新鞋给出相反的做法。双方以 WINJOB CP229 BOA 为基础，保留工作鞋结构，把鞋面、鞋底和旋钮处理成全黑；鞋跟、旋钮罩和鞋垫增加联名细节。ASICS 日本公布新款于 11 月 21 日发售，含税 23,100 日元；FASHIONSNAP 和 Mastered 均介绍，这是 ASICS WORKING 首次与服饰品牌合作。这个“首次”限定在工作鞋产品线，不是 ASICS 整个品牌。[ASICS 日本](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000344.000020802.html) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/asics-working-freshservice/) · [Mastered](https://mastered.jp/news/asicsworking-x-freshservice-20261121/)
stories.enDeck: ASICS WORKING and FreshService collaborate on a black WINJOB shoe.
stories.zhMarkdown:
一双工作鞋进入时装合作时，保护功能会不会先被拿掉？ASICS WORKING 与 FreshService 的新鞋给出相反的做法。双方以 WINJOB CP229 BOA 为基础，保留工作鞋结构，把鞋面、鞋底和旋钮处理成全黑；鞋跟、旋钮罩和鞋垫增加联名细节。ASICS 日本公布新款于 11 月 21 日发售，含税 23,100 日元；FASHIONSNAP 和 Mastered 均介绍，这是 ASICS WORKING 首次与服饰品牌合作。这个“首次”限定在工作鞋产品线，不是 ASICS 整个品牌。[ASICS 日本](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000344.000020802.html) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/asics-working-freshservice/) · [Mastered](https://mastered.jp/news/asicsworking-x-freshservice-20261121/)

新鞋的细节与工作动作有关：前掌有玻璃纤维强化树脂保护头，鞋底使用耐油橡胶与 CP Grip，旋钮系统可以戴着手套调节。ASICS 称这一联名款具有日本安全鞋协会 A 类认证，编号 4007；这一说法来自品牌，不能用历史认证表替代对联名货号的独立验证。[ASICS 公告](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000344.000020802.html)

《周刊 ASCII》今年 4 月借来基础款 CP229 BOA 试穿：作者说鞋底略硬，但中底带来缓冲，弯腰蹲下时鞋前部仍可弯折。评测对象是基础款，不是尚未上市的联名款，感受也只代表作者个人。[ASCII 试穿报道](https://weekly.ascii.jp/elem/000/004/387/4387240/2/)

FreshService 创办人南贵之在 Hypebeast 访谈中说，他把衣服当作“工具”，并从城市生活中具体的不便出发：想让布料更快干、更不易皱，却不一定要把极端户外装备的规格全部带进日常。他也提到，服务业制服需要听实际工作者对口袋位置和耐污的要求。这个思路与新鞋相接：外观向城市衣橱靠近，但产品并不需要因此忘掉戴手套、弯腰与行走这些动作。[Hypebeast 访谈](https://hypebeast.com/jp/2026/8/freshservice-takayukiminami-interviews)

两年前，南在 HONEYEE 的访谈中谈到自己经常穿 FreshService 与 Merrell 的合作鞋；HOUYHNHNM 当时记录了那双以徒步与越野鞋为基础、白色搭配荧光黄的鞋。更早的 GO OUT 文章则介绍过品牌与 Hi-TEC 的徒步鞋及与织物品牌 loomer 的工作服合作。它们并不证明这次安全鞋会有怎样的市场表现，却展示出 FreshService 一直在不同用途、制造者和日常穿着之间寻找连接。零售媒体 OPUMO 对其 2025 秋冬系列的介绍，也把制服与城市着装之间的关系作为观察角度。[HONEYEE 访谈](https://www.honeyee.com/detail/107635) · [HOUYHNHNM](https://www.houyhnhnm.jp/en/news/898278/) · [GO OUT](https://web.goout.jp/fashion/256663/) · [OPUMO](https://www.opumo.com/magazine/freshservice-aw25/)

发布活动也围绕动作而不是陈列展开。11 月 21 日至 29 日，东京神宫前 Gallery 85.4 将设置施工现场使用的脚手架，让试穿者走、攀、蹲来感受鞋子；11 月 25 日休馆。活动尚未开始，现有资料不能证明它的体验效果。更值得观察的是：当一双工作鞋被放进时装语境，它的保护结构是否仍被理解为功能，而不是只剩下外观的符号。[FASHIONSNAP 活动信息](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/asics-working-freshservice/) · [Hypebeast 报道](https://hypebeast.com/2026/11/asics-working-x-freshservice-winjob-cp229-boa-info)

南在 2022 年的 HONEYEE 采访中回忆，FreshService 最初以虚构运输公司的移动商店开始，后来才转为自有产品；他喜欢日常量产品中容易被忽视的价值。今年与鹿儿岛中村酒造场的对谈则更具体：酒造工作者需要应对冬季寒冷、油污与洗涤，制服设计由这些需求展开。这是另一项工作服合作，不能当成新鞋的使用测试。[HONEYEE 采访](https://www.honeyee.com/detail/83618) · [RiCE 对谈](https://www.rice.press/drink/34550)

活动场地也有一段相关背景。《Pen》2022 年走访 Gallery 85.4 时，南说自己希望它成为可容纳时装、艺术、家具或其他活动的灵活空间。这次放入脚手架的计划，延续了他对通过身体体验理解物件的兴趣；它本身依然是尚未开始的安排。[Pen 现场采访](https://www.pen-online.jp/article/011381.html)

ASICS 自有采访中，赛车技师薄井隆洋谈到工作时鞋的灵活度与抓地力；文章讨论的是另一款 CP229 BOA RR 3，并带有品牌宣传性质，不能当作本次联名的独立性能验证。[ASICS 人物采访](https://www.asics.com/jp/ja-jp/working/professional-stories/story05/)
stories.enMarkdown:
When a work shoe enters a fashion collaboration, does protection have to disappear? The new ASICS WORKING × FreshService pair takes the opposite approach. Based on the WINJOB CP229 BOA, it keeps the work-shoe construction and turns the upper, sole and dial black, adding collaborative details to the heel, dial cover and insole. ASICS Japan says the shoe will launch on November 21 for ¥23,100 including tax. FASHIONSNAP and Mastered describe it as ASICS WORKING’s first collaboration with an apparel brand—a claim about that work-shoe line, not the whole company. [ASICS Japan](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000344.000020802.html) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/asics-working-freshservice/) · [Mastered](https://mastered.jp/news/asicsworking-x-freshservice-20261121/)

Its details relate to movements at work: a glass-fibre-reinforced resin toe cap, an oil-resistant rubber outsole and CP Grip, and a dial that can be adjusted while wearing gloves. ASICS says the collaboration meets Japan Safety Appliances Association Class A under certification number 4007; that is the brand’s statement, not an independent verification of the collaboration’s specific product code. [ASICS announcement](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000344.000020802.html)

In April, Weekly ASCII borrowed the base CP229 BOA for a hands-on review. Its writer described a relatively firm outsole softened by the cushioning midsole, and noted that the forefoot could bend when crouching. The review concerns the base model, not the unreleased collaboration, and reflects one reviewer’s experience. [Weekly ASCII review](https://weekly.ascii.jp/elem/000/004/387/4387240/2/)

In a Hypebeast interview, FreshService founder Takayuki Minami described treating clothing as a tool and starting with small frustrations in urban life: wanting fabric to dry faster or wrinkle less without necessarily bringing every extreme-outdoor specification into the city. He also discussed listening to workers about practical needs, including pockets and resistance to stains. That approach connects to this shoe: its appearance can fit an everyday wardrobe while the design still attends to gloves, crouching and walking. [Hypebeast interview](https://hypebeast.com/jp/2026/8/freshservice-takayukiminami-interviews)

In a HONEYEE interview two years ago, Minami discussed wearing FreshService’s Merrell collaboration frequently. HOUYHNHNM described that white-and-neon-yellow pair as drawing on hiking and trail running. An earlier GO OUT article covered the label’s Hi-TEC hiking shoe and a workwear project with textile brand loomer. None proves how the new safety shoe will perform in the market; together they show a continuing interest in connecting different uses and makers to everyday dress. Retail publication OPUMO similarly framed FreshService’s autumn/winter 2025 collection around uniforms and city wear. [HONEYEE interview](https://www.honeyee.com/detail/107635) · [HOUYHNHNM](https://www.houyhnhnm.jp/en/news/898278/) · [GO OUT](https://web.goout.jp/fashion/256663/) · [OPUMO](https://www.opumo.com/magazine/freshservice-aw25/)

The launch event also places movement ahead of display. From November 21 to 29, Gallery 85.4 in Jingumae, Tokyo, plans to install construction-site scaffolding so visitors can walk, climb and crouch in the shoes; it closes on November 25. The event has not yet taken place, so there is no evidence here about how it will feel. The more interesting question is whether the protective structure remains understood as function when a work shoe enters fashion, rather than becoming only an aesthetic sign. [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/asics-working-freshservice/) · [Hypebeast](https://hypebeast.com/2026/11/asics-working-x-freshservice-winjob-cp229-boa-info)

In a 2022 HONEYEE interview, Minami recalled that FreshService began as a mobile shop imagined as a fictional delivery company before evolving into a maker of its own products. He valued overlooked qualities in ordinary mass-produced goods. In a separate 2026 conversation with Nakamura Distillery, the brewer described needs including winter warmth, resistance to oil and frequent washing; those needs shaped a different uniform collaboration and are not a test of the new shoe. [HONEYEE interview](https://www.honeyee.com/detail/83618) · [RiCE conversation](https://www.rice.press/drink/34550)

The venue has a relevant history. When Pen visited Gallery 85.4 in 2022, Minami described wanting a flexible space for fashion, art, furniture and other events, where people could experience objects physically. The planned scaffolding is consistent with that interest, although the new event has yet to happen. [Pen visit and interview](https://www.pen-online.jp/article/011381.html)

In an ASICS-published interview, racing mechanic Takahiro Usui discussed the importance of flexibility and grip at work. That branded article concerns a different CP229 BOA RR 3 model and cannot independently verify the collaboration’s performance. [ASICS profile](https://www.asics.com/jp/ja-jp/working/professional-stories/story05/)

stories.title: 纽约《Mirrored in Time》：当和纸、雨林与声音共享一个房间
stories.titleEn: Paper, Rainforest and Sound Share a Room
stories.zhDeck: 一幅油画、一张和纸版画和一件声音装置，能不能让人同时感到雨林、河水与一个房间的回响？纽约 Fridman Gallery 的群展《Mirrored in Time》计划于当地时间 11 月 11 日开幕，展至 12 月 13 日。画廊邀请 Alexa Kumiko Hatanaka、Naomi Lisiki、Will Maxen 与 Daniel Neumann，把风景、记忆和空间声音放在同一场展览中。开幕酒会定于 11 月 11 日晚 6 点至 8 点；目前展览尚未到纽约当地开幕时间。 [展览页面](https://fridmangallery.com/2026/10/11/exhibitions-mirrored-in-time-11-11-12-13-2026/)
stories.enDeck: Mirrored in Time brings works by three artists together in New York.
stories.zhMarkdown:
一幅油画、一张和纸版画和一件声音装置，能不能让人同时感到雨林、河水与一个房间的回响？纽约 Fridman Gallery 的群展《Mirrored in Time》计划于当地时间 11 月 11 日开幕，展至 12 月 13 日。画廊邀请 Alexa Kumiko Hatanaka、Naomi Lisiki、Will Maxen 与 Daniel Neumann，把风景、记忆和空间声音放在同一场展览中。开幕酒会定于 11 月 11 日晚 6 点至 8 点；目前展览尚未到纽约当地开幕时间。 [展览页面](https://fridmangallery.com/2026/10/11/exhibitions-mirrored-in-time-11-11-12-13-2026/)

画廊公布的作品中，Lisiki 的《Coeur des Tropiques》（2026）以油彩描绘既像热带雨林、又接近抽象的景象。Hatanaka 的《Ripples》（2025）则把手刻、手印的油毡版画放在定制手工楮皮和纸上；展方说，她关注水在流动与冻结时的形态。Maxen 的《The Sun Beyond This One》（2026）以油彩和丙烯画在画布上，人物与风景在画廊的描述中互相交织。这里对展品的判断来自主办方资料，最终呈现仍需观众到场确认。 [展览页面](https://fridmangallery.com/2026/10/11/exhibitions-mirrored-in-time-11-11-12-13-2026/)

和纸对于 Hatanaka 不只是画面的底材。她在 Foyer 的访谈中说，自己从 2009 年学习版画时开始使用和纸，2011 年学习造纸；她逐渐关注纸的韧性，以及它作为可穿戴材料的可能。Studio Magazine 的另一篇访谈里，她谈到在尊重工艺的同时，将个人与离散文化经验带进传统。两篇访谈讨论的是她更广泛的实践，不是对这次纽约展览的现场记录。 [Foyer](https://readfoyer.com/article/alexa-kumiko-hatanakas-washi-futures) · [Studio Magazine](https://www.studiomagazine.ca/articles/2024/2/alexa-kumiko-hatanaka)

这种材料观也体现在工作方法里。艺术家介绍，她会保留裁剪下来的纸片并重新拼接，也会使用蒟蒻处理和纸，使其更柔韧、便于缝制。《Public Parking》对她工作过程的实地采访记录了她受传统纸制消防服启发制作的作品；Observer 的访谈则写到她在日本高知纸坊学习采收和加工楮皮。这些是理解她如何与材料相处的背景，不应误写成《Ripples》的制作记录。 [艺术家方法说明](https://alexahatanaka.com/materials-processes) · [Public Parking](https://thisispublicparking.com/posts/profiles-artist-alexa-hatanaka-s-practice-asks-how-we-might-learn-to-live-attentively-within-unstable-conditions) · [Observer](https://observer.com/2026/09/artist-interview-alexa-hatanaka-washi-bipolarity-venice-biennale/)

Lisiki 则从另一条路径处理风景。在 2025 年接受 Bode Gallery 的访谈时，她回忆加勒比地区的童年、搬到纽约后的思乡，以及绘画如何成为表达个人经验的空间。她把作品看作一种可以进入的体验，而不仅是一幅可观看的图像。这个说法来自艺术家对自身创作的解释，不等同于对观众感受的保证。 [Bode Gallery 访谈](https://bode.gallery/blog/69-in-conversation-with-naomi-lisiki-episode-36/)

展览中的声音作品也把注意力拉回身体。画廊称 Neumann 的《Dilation (Excerpt from Day #399)》（2026）采用八声道，通过持续音与画廊空间的声学条件形成拍频、干涉和细微变化。另有关于声音的媒体报道解释了相近频率之间出现拍频的基本机制，但它沿用旧展名，且以画廊为信息来源；作品名称与展期仍以主办方为准。 [展览页面](https://fridmangallery.com/2026/10/11/exhibitions-mirrored-in-time-11-11-12-13-2026/) · [Audient](https://audientconsciousness.com/daniel-neumann-dilation-fridman-gallery/)

这种把空间当成声音一部分的做法，在 Neumann 的旧作里已出现。2018 年，Ravelin Magazine 采访他谈《Channels》：声音随听者位置而改变，设备与房间本身参与作品。Storefront for Art and Architecture 同年介绍了他将该作品的声音材料重新带入另一座建筑的演出；在与 Lee Gilboa 的书面对谈中，Neumann 也谈到会通过拍手来感受一个空间的声学响应。三份材料分别涉及过去的创作，不能替代对新作的实地聆听。 [Ravelin](https://ravelinmagazine.com/posts/daniel-neumanns-channels-fridman-gallery/) · [Storefront](https://storefront.nyc/program/listening-series-playing-spaces/) · [对谈 PDF](https://w.contoureditions.com/releases/ce.onl_0036/Channels-Gilboa_Neumann_Conversation.pdf)

这场展览值得关注的地方，是它让不同尺度的时间靠近：纸上的纤维和印痕、画中带着个人记忆的风景、以及只能在当下经历的声音。11 月 14 日画廊还计划举办 International Contemporary Ensemble 演出，12 月 5 日有艺术家谈话与聆听活动。展览是否能把这些线索真正连成一个经验，还需要等开幕后再看。 [展览与活动安排](https://fridmangallery.com/2026/10/11/exhibitions-mirrored-in-time-11-11-12-13-2026/)
stories.enMarkdown:
Can a painting, a print on washi and a sound installation make a rainforest, moving water and a room’s resonance feel close together? *Mirrored in Time* is scheduled to open at New York’s Fridman Gallery on November 11 and continue through December 13. Alexa Kumiko Hatanaka, Naomi Lisiki, Will Maxen and Daniel Neumann bring landscape, memory and spatial sound into one exhibition. The opening reception is planned for 6–8 p.m. New York time on November 11; at the time of writing, it has not yet opened there. [Gallery](https://fridmangallery.com/2026/10/11/exhibitions-mirrored-in-time-11-11-12-13-2026/)

Among the works listed by the gallery, Lisiki’s oil painting *Coeur des Tropiques* (2026) evokes both a rainforest and abstraction. Hatanaka’s *Ripples* (2025) is a hand-carved, hand-printed linocut on custom handmade kozo paper; the gallery connects her work to water in its moving and frozen forms. Maxen’s *The Sun Beyond This One* (2026) uses oil and acrylic on canvas, with figures and landscapes interwoven in the gallery’s description. These accounts come from the organiser’s material; the final installation remains to be seen. [Gallery](https://fridmangallery.com/2026/10/11/exhibitions-mirrored-in-time-11-11-12-13-2026/)

For Hatanaka, washi is more than a surface to print on. She told Foyer that she began using it while studying printmaking in 2009 and learned papermaking in 2011, later becoming interested in its strength and possibilities as a wearable material. In a separate Studio Magazine interview, she discussed bringing personal and diasporic perspectives to traditional crafts while respecting the knowledge behind them. Both interviews concern her wider practice, not a first-hand account of this New York exhibition. [Foyer](https://readfoyer.com/article/alexa-kumiko-hatanakas-washi-futures) · [Studio Magazine](https://www.studiomagazine.ca/articles/2024/2/alexa-kumiko-hatanaka)

That approach extends to her process. The artist describes saving and reusing paper offcuts, and treating washi with konnyaku to make it more flexible for sewing. Public Parking’s reported visit describes a work inspired by historical paper firefighters’ jackets; an Observer interview recounts her learning to harvest and prepare kozo at a paper mill in Kochi, Japan. These are useful contexts for the artist’s practice, not a documented production history of *Ripples*. [Artist’s process](https://alexahatanaka.com/materials-processes) · [Public Parking](https://thisispublicparking.com/posts/profiles-artist-alexa-hatanaka-s-practice-asks-how-we-might-learn-to-live-attentively-within-unstable-conditions) · [Observer](https://observer.com/2026/09/artist-interview-alexa-hatanaka-washi-bipolarity-venice-biennale/)

Lisiki approaches landscape from another direction. In a 2025 interview with Bode Gallery, she remembered her childhood in the Caribbean and homesickness after moving to New York, describing painting as a space in which to express lived experience. She spoke of it as an experience rather than a purely visual object: the artist’s own account of her work, not a guarantee of what every visitor will feel. [Bode Gallery interview](https://bode.gallery/blog/69-in-conversation-with-naomi-lisiki-episode-36/)

The sound work brings attention back to the body. According to the gallery, Neumann’s *Dilation (Excerpt from Day #399)* (2026) uses eight channels, tuning sustained tones to the gallery’s acoustics to create beating, interference and subtle shifts. A sound publication explains the basic mechanism of beating between close frequencies, but uses an earlier exhibition title and cites the gallery; the organiser remains the source for the current title and dates. [Gallery](https://fridmangallery.com/2026/10/11/exhibitions-mirrored-in-time-11-11-12-13-2026/) · [Audient](https://audientconsciousness.com/daniel-neumann-dilation-fridman-gallery/)

Treating a room as part of the sound is a longstanding concern for Neumann. In a 2018 Ravelin interview about his earlier *Channels*, he described sound changing with the listener’s position and the equipment and room participating in the work. Storefront for Art and Architecture documented a later performance that took material from *Channels* into another building; in a written conversation with Lee Gilboa, Neumann described clapping to hear a room’s acoustic response. These accounts concern earlier works and cannot replace listening to the new installation. [Ravelin](https://ravelinmagazine.com/posts/daniel-neumanns-channels-fridman-gallery/) · [Storefront](https://storefront.nyc/program/listening-series-playing-spaces/) · [Written conversation](https://w.contoureditions.com/releases/ce.onl_0036/Channels-Gilboa_Neumann_Conversation.pdf)

The exhibition brings several scales of time together: fibres and impressions in paper, landscapes carrying personal memory, and sound experienced in the present. The gallery also plans an International Contemporary Ensemble performance on November 14 and an artist talk and listening session on December 5. How the works connect as an experience is a question to revisit after opening. [Gallery schedule](https://fridmangallery.com/2026/10/11/exhibitions-mirrored-in-time-11-11-12-13-2026/)

stories.title: 上海荣宅《传奇》：让四个房间重新讲故事
stories.titleEn: Four Rooms Tell New Stories at Shanghai’s Rong Zhai
stories.zhDeck: 一座老宅的舞厅、北厅、台球室和卧室，即将分别成为四段故事的入口。上海 Prada 荣宅展览《传奇：与荣宅的跨时空对话》由巫鸿策展，邀请耿雪、彭薇、宋冬和谢晓泽以影像、绘画和装置回应建筑中的不同房间。主办方公布的公众展期是 2026 年 11 月 12 日至 2027 年 2 月 28 日；11 月 11 日的艺术周活动安排与公众开放日期需分开理解。 [Prada 展览页面](https://www.prada.com/eu/en/pradasphere/special-projects/2026/chuanqi-prada-rong-zhai.html)
stories.enDeck: Chuanqi: Spacetime Dialogues is scheduled to open to the public on November 12.
stories.zhMarkdown:
一座老宅的舞厅、北厅、台球室和卧室，即将分别成为四段故事的入口。上海 Prada 荣宅展览《传奇：与荣宅的跨时空对话》由巫鸿策展，邀请耿雪、彭薇、宋冬和谢晓泽以影像、绘画和装置回应建筑中的不同房间。主办方公布的公众展期是 2026 年 11 月 12 日至 2027 年 2 月 28 日；11 月 11 日的艺术周活动安排与公众开放日期需分开理解。 [Prada 展览页面](https://www.prada.com/eu/en/pradasphere/special-projects/2026/chuanqi-prada-rong-zhai.html)

“传奇”在这里既指古代叙事传统，也是一种看待房间的方法：一件作品进入曾有特定用途的空间，现实里的家具、建筑和人的记忆，便有机会和虚构相遇。荣宅经过修缮后于 2017 年重新开放；这次展览的作品分布在建筑两层，而不是集中在一个白盒子里。以下有关新展的空间安排均来自主办方说明，并非我们的现场观察。 [Prada 展览页面](https://www.prada.com/eu/en/pradasphere/special-projects/2026/chuanqi-prada-rong-zhai.html) · [荣宅修缮介绍](https://www.pradagroup.com/en/perspectives/stories/sezione-progetti-speciali/prada-rong-zhai.html)

宋冬为舞厅构思了一件可互动的现场装置：地面镜面映出天花板，并与经过处理的日常家具共同构成空间。对熟悉他创作的人来说，“家”与日常物并不陌生。MoMA 对 2009 年旧展的记录介绍，《物尽其用》源自宋冬与母亲共同整理她保留下来的生活物件；他在 ART iT 访谈中特别强调，2005 年首次呈现作品时母亲仍在世。这是理解其创作的一条线索，不表示旧作会出现在荣宅。 [MoMA](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/960) · [ART iT 访谈](https://www.art-it.asia/en/u/admin_interviews_e/giD39m1wnJVsqkl8eb0T/)

彭薇的三十余件作品将进入原台球室与吸烟室：主办方认为，这两间装饰相连的房间曾可能服务于男性休闲，而她以女性为中心的绘画、装置和动画跨越古代、民国与当代。另一场在萨尔茨堡的旧展研究介绍，她曾在《旧闻新说》中重新处理古代女性故事；普林斯顿大学记录的 2023 年工作坊则让人看到她对笔墨和呼吸的关注。这些历史材料丰富了观看背景，也不应被当作本次展品清单。 [Prada](https://www.prada.com/eu/en/pradasphere/special-projects/2026/chuanqi-prada-rong-zhai.html) · [Museum der Moderne 图录](https://www.museumdermoderne.at/fileadmin/user_upload/Ausstellungen/Stepping_Out_/MdMS_Stepping_Out_Booklet_EN.pdf) · [普林斯顿大学](https://artandarchaeology.princeton.edu/whats/news/learning-artist-peng-wei)

耿雪的影像装置安排在面向花园的北厅。她长期把陶瓷、雕塑与影像结合：UCCA 的展览文字介绍，她此前的《金色之名》与怀孕、生产经验有关，而不是古代传说改编；画廊 Vermilion 的旧展图录收录了艺术家对影片泥塑人物与金色巨物的自述。两份资料谈的是旧作品，不代表《金色之名》本次在荣宅展出。 [UCCA](https://ucca.org.cn/en/exhibition/improvisational-drift-new-directions-in-ceramics/audios/) · [Vermilion 图录](https://vermilionart.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/GENG-XUE-e-Catalogue_Vermilion-Art.pdf)

谢晓泽的作品将置于原荣氏夫人卧室。他从敦煌藏经洞出发，主办方称这次将以九件半透明、3D 打印的树脂雕塑组成曼荼罗式布局，并结合水墨与投影。谢晓泽在芝加哥大学的访谈中回忆，他 2017 年驻留敦煌时从记录、引文与图像组成的水墨长卷开始，后来才发展出立体作品；他也提醒，自己的做法属于艺术想象，而不是考古复原。该访谈由巫鸿任职的研究中心发表，与本次策展人存在机构关联。 [Prada](https://www.prada.com/eu/en/pradasphere/special-projects/2026/chuanqi-prada-rong-zhai.html) · [芝加哥大学访谈](https://caea.lib.uchicago.edu/dcadp/en/cparallels/xiexiaoze/)

这项围绕藏经洞展开的创作也有此前和即将到来的不同版本：清华大学艺术博物馆 2025 年介绍过长卷、树脂雕塑与多媒体之间的关系；美国 Bowers Museum 则计划在 2026 年 12 月起展示另一种组合。两馆的作品及布置不一定与荣宅相同，且清华旧展同由巫鸿策展、Bowers 图录有他的文章，不能当作对本次展览的独立现场核验。 [清华大学艺术博物馆](https://www.artmuseum.tsinghua.edu.cn/en/cpsj_english/zlxx/zlhg/202502/t20250226_19869.shtml) · [Bowers Museum](https://www.bowers.org/index.php/xie)

这场展览的吸引力，或许就在于让房间继续保留自己的身份：舞厅仍让人想到聚会，台球室仍留下旧式生活的痕迹，而新的作品把这些用途重新变成可以提问的对象。它们最终怎样彼此作用，要等公众进入现场之后才能判断。
stories.enMarkdown:
A ballroom, a north chamber, a billiards room and a bedroom will each become the starting point for a different story. *Chuanqi: Spacetime Dialogues at Rong Zhai*, curated by Wu Hung, brings work by Geng Xue, Peng Wei, Song Dong and Xiaoze Xie into Shanghai’s Prada Rong Zhai. The organiser gives November 12, 2026 through February 28, 2027 as the public exhibition dates; an art-week event on November 11 should not be confused with public opening. [Prada exhibition](https://www.prada.com/eu/en/pradasphere/special-projects/2026/chuanqi-prada-rong-zhai.html)

Here, *chuanqi* refers to a historical narrative tradition as well as a way of looking at rooms. When an artwork enters a space once used for a particular purpose, furniture, architecture and personal memory can meet fiction. Rong Zhai reopened in 2017 after restoration. The exhibition places the works across two levels of the residence rather than in a single neutral gallery. The descriptions of the new installation below come from the organiser, not from a visit. [Prada exhibition](https://www.prada.com/eu/en/pradasphere/special-projects/2026/chuanqi-prada-rong-zhai.html) · [Restoration](https://www.pradagroup.com/en/perspectives/stories/sezione-progetti-speciali/prada-rong-zhai.html)

Song Dong has conceived an interactive installation for the ballroom. A mirrored floor reflects the ceiling, while transformed pieces of everyday furniture help shape the room. Home and ordinary objects are familiar concerns in his work. MoMA’s account of a 2009 exhibition explains that *Waste Not* grew from a collaboration with his mother, organising the belongings she had kept; in an ART iT interview, Song emphasised that she was alive when the work was first assembled in 2005. This earlier project offers context and is not listed here as a work in the Rong Zhai show. [MoMA](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/960) · [ART iT interview](https://www.art-it.asia/en/u/admin_interviews_e/giD39m1wnJVsqkl8eb0T/)

More than thirty works by Peng Wei will occupy the former billiards and smoking rooms. The organiser suggests that the coordinated rooms were probably conceived for men’s leisure; Peng’s female-centred paintings, installations and animation connect ancient, Republican-era and contemporary narratives. An earlier exhibition booklet from Salzburg discusses her reworking of historical stories about women in *Old Tales Retold*. Princeton’s account of her 2023 workshop, meanwhile, describes her attention to brushwork and breathing. These past projects inform the discussion without serving as an inventory of the Shanghai exhibition. [Prada](https://www.prada.com/eu/en/pradasphere/special-projects/2026/chuanqi-prada-rong-zhai.html) · [Museum der Moderne booklet](https://www.museumdermoderne.at/fileadmin/user_upload/Ausstellungen/Stepping_Out_/MdMS_Stepping_Out_Booklet_EN.pdf) · [Princeton](https://artandarchaeology.princeton.edu/whats/news/learning-artist-peng-wei)

Geng Xue’s video installation is planned for the north chamber overlooking the garden. She has long combined ceramics, sculpture and film. UCCA’s account of an earlier work, *The Name of Gold*, connects it to pregnancy and childbirth rather than a historical legend; a Vermilion Gallery catalogue includes her own description of its clay figures and enormous golden form. Both sources concern a previous work and do not establish that it is included at Rong Zhai. [UCCA](https://ucca.org.cn/en/exhibition/improvisational-drift-new-directions-in-ceramics/audios/) · [Vermilion catalogue](https://vermilionart.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/GENG-XUE-e-Catalogue_Vermilion-Art.pdf)

Xiaoze Xie’s work will occupy the former bedroom of Mrs. Yung. Taking Dunhuang’s Library Cave as a point of departure, the installation is described by Prada as nine semi-transparent 3D-printed resin sculptures arranged in a mandala-like configuration, accompanied by ink drawings and projection. In a University of Chicago interview, Xie recalled beginning with an ink scroll combining notes, quotations and images during his 2017 Dunhuang residency, before developing sculptural works. He also distinguished his imaginative artistic approach from archaeological reconstruction. The interview was published by a centre directed by this exhibition’s curator, Wu Hung. [Prada](https://www.prada.com/eu/en/pradasphere/special-projects/2026/chuanqi-prada-rong-zhai.html) · [University of Chicago interview](https://caea.lib.uchicago.edu/dcadp/en/cparallels/xiexiaoze/)

The Library Cave project has appeared in different forms and will travel again. Tsinghua University Art Museum’s 2025 exhibition described the relationship between the scroll, resin sculptures and multimedia works; California’s Bowers Museum plans a different presentation from December 2026. Neither institution’s selection or arrangement should be assumed to match Rong Zhai. Wu Hung curated the Tsinghua show and contributes to the Bowers catalogue, so neither account independently verifies the present installation. [Tsinghua University Art Museum](https://www.artmuseum.tsinghua.edu.cn/en/cpsj_english/zlxx/zlhg/202502/t20250226_19869.shtml) · [Bowers Museum](https://www.bowers.org/index.php/xie)

The appeal of the exhibition may lie in letting the rooms retain their identities. The ballroom still suggests a gathering; the billiards room bears traces of an older way of living. New works invite questions about those uses and the people associated with them. How the different elements interact will become clearer once the public can enter.

stories.title: UCHE YARA 的《FUGAZY》：把面具带进两个人的表演
stories.titleEn: UCHE YARA and TaliaBle Put Masks into Motion
stories.zhDeck: UCHE YARA 与 TaliaBle 的《FUGAZY》影像，把一首合作曲变成两个人面对镜头的表演。11 月 9 日发布的录像在伦敦拍摄，由同时参与歌曲的 TaliaBle 掌镜；两人在片中使用超现实面具。音乐人的公关资料介绍了这一拍摄形式。[官方发布资料](https://twntythree.com/berlins-uche-yara-shares-new-music-video-for-fugazy/) · [Fame Magazine](https://www.famemagazine.co.uk/uche-yara-and-taliable-get-surreal-in-the-fugazy-video/)
stories.enDeck: The new FUGAZY video turns collaboration into a two-person performance.
stories.zhMarkdown:
UCHE YARA 与 TaliaBle 的《FUGAZY》影像，把一首合作曲变成两个人面对镜头的表演。11 月 9 日发布的录像在伦敦拍摄，由同时参与歌曲的 TaliaBle 掌镜；两人在片中使用超现实面具。音乐人的公关资料介绍了这一拍摄形式。[官方发布资料](https://twntythree.com/berlins-uche-yara-shares-new-music-video-for-fugazy/) · [Fame Magazine](https://www.famemagazine.co.uk/uche-yara-and-taliable-get-surreal-in-the-fugazy-video/)

这首歌收在 YARA 于 9 月发行的首张专辑《BODYSCANNER》中，TaliaBle 也与 SHEIVA 出现在另一首《belt to belt》。Neon Music 对公开制作名单的核对显示，《FUGAZY》的制作并非只有一个名字：UCHE YARA、MNPHB 与 Alex the Flipper 均列入制作名单。把多人的角色写清楚，比把整个项目都概括成一个人“独自完成”更准确。[Neon Music](https://neonmusic.co.uk/uche-yara-fugazy-video-taliable-london) · [The Line of Best Fit](https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/uche-yara-reveals-plans-for-debut-album-bodyscanner)

《BODYSCANNER》中的“身体”，既是舞蹈的起点，也涉及被看见时的不安。YARA 在 OFFKEY 的采访中谈到，能否卸下外层取决于身处的空间是否安全；她把俱乐部里被看见与被观察的张力带进同名曲。奥地利广播电台 FM4 的访问则记录了她如何从打击乐、节奏和非常规音色走向制作，也提到柏林酷儿社群帮助她重新理解舞动和连接。[OFFKEY](https://nbhap.com/berlin/uche-yara-bodyscanner) · [FM4](https://fm4.orf.at/story/uche-yara-album-bodyscanner-100) 她在 The Gap 的另一篇采访中说，自己曾在柏林难以找到归属；后来遇见让她感到受尊重的空间，也重新理解了集体舞动与被观察之间的关系。[The Gap](https://thegap.at/uche-yara/)

专辑中的不同角色并不都采取同一种姿态。Soundkartell 把《hello hello》读作对集体麻木的警醒，并把《be something》与持续自我优化的压力联系起来；She Makes Music 则介绍《DIVA CLUB》原本以一支混乱的轮滑队队长为角色设想。MusikBlog 的乐评注意到整张专辑在电子、嘻哈和实验流行之间切换。这些是各评论者的听感，而不是歌曲意义的唯一答案。[Soundkartell](https://www.soundkartell.de/album-uche-yara-bodyscanner/) · [She Makes Music](https://shemakesmusic.co.uk/new-music/uche-yara-takes-up-space-on-euphoric-diva-club/) · [MusikBlog](https://www.musikblog.de/2026/09/uche-yara-bodyscanner/)

她在 BR24 的采访中回忆，过去跳舞时会因觉得自己被注视而拘束；制作专辑的过程让舞蹈逐渐成为情绪的出口。更早的 2025 年，她告诉 The Berliner，自己在录音室会亲自演奏乐器，也记得前一年在 Berghain Kantine 的首场个人演出。这些经历为《FUGAZY》里的身体与表演提供了背景。[BR24](https://www.br.de/nachrichten/kultur/viel-lust-auf-experimente-bodyscanner-von-uche-yara,VWi9ESl) · [The Berliner](https://www.the-berliner.com/music-clubs/uche-yara-berlin-alt-pop-performer-interview/)
stories.enMarkdown:
UCHE YARA and TaliaBle turn their collaboration “FUGAZY” into a two-person performance for the camera. Released on November 9, the video was filmed in London by TaliaBle, who also appears on the track; both performers use surreal masks. The artist’s publicity release describes that visual approach. [Artist publicity](https://twntythree.com/berlins-uche-yara-shares-new-music-video-for-fugazy/) · [Fame Magazine](https://www.famemagazine.co.uk/uche-yara-and-taliable-get-surreal-in-the-fugazy-video/)

The song appears on YARA’s debut album *BODYSCANNER*, released in September. TaliaBle also joins SHEIVA on another track, “belt to belt.” Neon Music’s account of the published credits names UCHE YARA, MNPHB and Alex the Flipper as producers of “FUGAZY.” Naming those roles is more accurate than describing every part of the project as the work of one person alone. [Neon Music](https://neonmusic.co.uk/uche-yara-fugazy-video-taliable-london) · [The Line of Best Fit](https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/uche-yara-reveals-plans-for-debut-album-bodyscanner)

The body in *BODYSCANNER* is both a starting point for dance and a site of unease about being seen. In an OFFKEY interview, YARA said the ability to remove one’s layers depends on whether a space feels safe. She brought the tension between being seen and being observed in a club into the title track. Austrian broadcaster FM4 traced her path from percussion and unconventional sounds toward production, and described the role of Berlin’s queer communities in changing her relationship with movement and connection. [OFFKEY](https://nbhap.com/berlin/uche-yara-bodyscanner) · [FM4](https://fm4.orf.at/story/uche-yara-album-bodyscanner-100) In a separate interview with The Gap, she described struggling to find a sense of belonging in Berlin, then encountering spaces where she felt respected and reconsidering the relationship between collective dancing and being observed. [The Gap](https://thegap.at/uche-yara/)

The album’s characters do not all take the same stance. Soundkartell heard “hello hello” as an alarm about collective numbness and connected “be something” with the pressure of constant self-improvement. She Makes Music described “DIVA CLUB” as originally imagined around the captain of a chaotic roller-derby team. MusikBlog noticed the album moving among electronic music, hip-hop and experimental pop. These are individual critical readings, not the only meanings the songs can hold. [Soundkartell](https://www.soundkartell.de/album-uche-yara-bodyscanner/) · [She Makes Music](https://shemakesmusic.co.uk/new-music/uche-yara-takes-up-space-on-euphoric-diva-club/) · [MusikBlog](https://www.musikblog.de/2026/09/uche-yara-bodyscanner/)

In an interview with BR24, she recalled feeling watched and inhibited when dancing; making the album gradually turned dance into an outlet for emotion. In 2025 she told The Berliner that she played instruments herself in the studio, and remembered her first headline show at Berghain Kantine the year before. These experiences offer context for the bodies and performances in “FUGAZY.” [BR24](https://www.br.de/nachrichten/kultur/viel-lust-auf-experimente-bodyscanner-von-uche-yara,VWi9ESl) · [The Berliner](https://www.the-berliner.com/music-clubs/uche-yara-berlin-alt-pop-performer-interview/)

stories.title: YOSHIROTTEN × Globe-Trotter：三只箱子拼出一幅宇宙图
stories.titleEn: Three Cases Form One Image
stories.zhDeck: 三只行李箱并排放在一起，才是一幅完整的图。艺术家 YOSHIROTTEN 与 Globe-Trotter 围绕他的作品《SUPERNOVA》制作旅行箱，品牌于 11 月 9 日公布具体销售安排：11 月 16 日中午在日本官网开售，全球限量六组，每组三只，含税 181.5 万日元。这里的数量是六组而不是六只；FASHIONSNAP 标题写“六台”，正文和品牌资料都写明六组。[品牌制作说明](https://jp.globe-trotter.com/blogs/journal/beyond-earth-yoshirotten) · [品牌销售公告](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000072.000024442.html) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/yoshirotten-beyond-earth/)
stories.enDeck: YOSHIROTTEN and Globe-Trotter put a cosmic image across a set of cases.
stories.zhMarkdown:
三只行李箱并排放在一起，才是一幅完整的图。艺术家 YOSHIROTTEN 与 Globe-Trotter 围绕他的作品《SUPERNOVA》制作旅行箱，品牌于 11 月 9 日公布具体销售安排：11 月 16 日中午在日本官网开售，全球限量六组，每组三只，含税 181.5 万日元。这里的数量是六组而不是六只；FASHIONSNAP 标题写“六台”，正文和品牌资料都写明六组。[品牌制作说明](https://jp.globe-trotter.com/blogs/journal/beyond-earth-yoshirotten) · [品牌销售公告](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000072.000024442.html) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/yoshirotten-beyond-earth/)

黑色硫化纤维板上，蓝、橙、粉与绿组成类似星云和地平线的色带。品牌制作文章记录，艺术家需要先把横向画面拆到三个箱体上，再调整各自的构图与色彩；他也说，在黑色板材上得到想要的颜色并非直接打印就能解决，而是经过反复试验。箱内有手写签名及编号，每只约 34 升。一组可以拆开旅行，也可以在家并排观看：画面由日常物件的排列来完成。[品牌制作说明](https://jp.globe-trotter.com/blogs/journal/beyond-earth-yoshirotten) · [品牌公告](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000072.000024442.html)

箱子与东京 TOKYO NODE 的《BEYOND EARTH》个展有关。展方介绍，展览从 2026 年 10 月 30 日持续至 2027 年 1 月 11 日，把艺术家长期关心的自然、光、色彩与看不见的现象放在一起；JAXA 参与企划合作。YOSHIROTTEN 在 Pen 访谈中回忆，站在 45 楼看东京时，视线逐渐转向天空，才想到让展览与宇宙“交信”。艺术家与河口洋一郎的对谈中，他解释《Supernova》来自对超新星爆发前过程的想象。它是艺术家的创作设想，不应被写成对某次真实天文事件的纪录。[TOKYO NODE](https://www.tokyonode.jp/events/yoshirotten/index.html) · [Pen 采访](https://www.pen-online.jp/article/022405.html) · [ブレーン对谈](https://www.sendenkaigi.com/creative/media/brain/pztobf7zww55/)

独立现场报道帮助我们区分展览和商品。《美术手帖》记录了展厅与东京自然光的关系：城市景色与发光作品共同构成空间。Amuzen 的现场文章列出《Puddle Cygnus X-1》和《Supernova》等展览作品；GAME MEDIA 记录了开幕前的发布活动与屋顶联动项目。它们讨论的是展览，不等于说行李箱本身含有 JAXA 的观测数据，也不能据此推断每件箱子的独立创作过程。[《美术手帖》现场报道](https://bijutsutecho.com/magazine/news/report/33265) · [Amuzen](https://amuzen.org/yoshirotten-exhibition-tokyo-node-2026-2027-review/) · [GAME MEDIA](https://game.mirai-media.net/yoshirotten-beyond-earth/)

YOSHIROTTEN 的作品经常跨越屏幕、场地与物件。在 TOKION 的 2023 年采访中，他回忆自己从 2020 年疫情期间开始每天制作一幅《SUN》，后来决定连续制作一年；2022 年他首次把这一系列带到静冈的户外音乐活动，以立体装置呈现。《美术手帖》2024 年采访记录他童年对一排屏幕保护程序的记忆；IMA 则与他讨论图像、空间和设计工作之间的关系。这些是对他此前实践的回顾，并非行李箱的制作记录。[TOKION 专访](https://tokion.jp/2023/04/26/interview-yoshirotten-sun/) · [《美术手帖》采访](https://bijutsutecho.com/magazine/interview/28660) · [IMA 专访](https://imaonline.jp/articles/interview/YOSHIROTTEN/)

在 ARTnews JAPAN 对他 2024 年鹿儿岛美术馆展览的现场采访中，他谈到用当地采集的光线、声音和自然表面扫描图像制作数字作品。2026 年 HIDDEN CHAMPION 的另一篇采访则记录《Menhir》如何把地点的光线数据转为变化的画面，并将其中的瞬间打印到板材上。两项旧作品并不等同于这套箱子的工艺，但它们帮助理解他为何持续在变化的光、静止图像和物件表面之间转换。此次行李箱可看作这种尺度转换的另一种尝试，而非我们已经验证的观众体验。[ARTnews JAPAN 采访](https://artnewsjapan.com/article/14708) · [HIDDEN CHAMPION 采访](https://hiddenchampion.jp/interview/interview-yoshirotten/)
stories.enMarkdown:
Three suitcases become one image when placed side by side. Artist YOSHIROTTEN and Globe-Trotter have made a set based on his work *SUPERNOVA*. On November 9 the brand published sales details: six sets, each containing three cases, are scheduled for release on its Japanese online store at noon on November 16, priced at ¥1,815,000 per set including tax. The quantity is six sets, not six individual cases; a FASHIONSNAP headline says six cases, while its body and the brand both specify six sets. [Brand’s making-of](https://jp.globe-trotter.com/blogs/journal/beyond-earth-yoshirotten) · [Sales announcement](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000072.000024442.html) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/yoshirotten-beyond-earth/)

Blue, orange, pink and green cross the black vulcanised-fibreboard cases in bands recalling nebulae and horizons. The brand’s making-of describes how the artist extended a horizontal image over three separate bodies and adjusted each composition. He also says achieving the intended colours on black board took repeated trials rather than simply printing the original image. Each case has a capacity of approximately 34 litres, and the interior carries a handwritten signature and serial number. The pieces can travel separately or be viewed together at home; the arrangement of ordinary objects completes the image. [Making-of](https://jp.globe-trotter.com/blogs/journal/beyond-earth-yoshirotten) · [Announcement](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000072.000024442.html)

The set accompanies *BEYOND EARTH*, YOSHIROTTEN’s exhibition at TOKYO NODE. The venue gives the dates as October 30, 2026 to January 11, 2027, and describes a practice bringing nature, light, colour and unseen phenomena together; JAXA provided planning cooperation. In an interview with Pen, the artist recalled looking out over Tokyo from the 45th floor and gradually raising his gaze to the sky, leading him to think about communicating with space. In a separate conversation with artist Yoichiro Kawaguchi, he described *Supernova* as an imagined drama before a stellar explosion. It is an artistic conception, not documentation of a particular astronomical event. [TOKYO NODE](https://www.tokyonode.jp/events/yoshirotten/index.html) · [Pen interview](https://www.pen-online.jp/article/022405.html) · [Brain conversation](https://www.sendenkaigi.com/creative/media/brain/pztobf7zww55/)

Independent exhibition reports help separate the show from the product. Bijutsu Techo describes how natural light and the view of Tokyo become part of the installation alongside illuminated works. Amuzen lists *Puddle Cygnus X-1* and *Supernova* among the works seen at the venue; GAME MEDIA reports on the opening presentation and rooftop programme. These sources describe the exhibition: they do not establish that the suitcases themselves contain JAXA observation data, nor do they document the making of each individual case. [Bijutsu Techo report](https://bijutsutecho.com/magazine/news/report/33265) · [Amuzen](https://amuzen.org/yoshirotten-exhibition-tokyo-node-2026-2027-review/) · [GAME MEDIA](https://game.mirai-media.net/yoshirotten-beyond-earth/)

YOSHIROTTEN’s practice often crosses screens, spaces and objects. In a 2023 TOKION interview he recalled beginning to make one *SUN* image each day during the pandemic in 2020, later deciding to continue for a year. In 2022 he first brought the series to an outdoor music event in Shizuoka as a physical installation. A 2024 Bijutsu Techo interview records his childhood encounter with rows of screensavers; IMA discussed his work across graphics, space and design. These are accounts of earlier practice, not documentation of the suitcases’ production. [TOKION interview](https://tokion.jp/2023/04/26/interview-yoshirotten-sun/) · [Bijutsu Techo interview](https://bijutsutecho.com/magazine/interview/28660) · [IMA interview](https://imaonline.jp/articles/interview/YOSHIROTTEN/)

In ARTnews JAPAN’s on-site interview at his 2024 Kagoshima museum exhibition, he described making digital works from locally gathered light, sound and scans of natural surfaces. In a separate 2026 HIDDEN CHAMPION interview he explained how *Menhir* turns light data from a place into a changing image, with selected moments printed onto panels. Neither earlier work documents the suitcase’s manufacture, but both help explain his continued movement between changing light, still images and object surfaces. The cases can be read as another change of scale, not as evidence of a particular audience experience. [ARTnews JAPAN interview](https://artnewsjapan.com/article/14708) · [HIDDEN CHAMPION interview](https://hiddenchampion.jp/interview/interview-yoshirotten/)

stories.title: BEAMS × Nontan：把绘本里睡着的朋友带进房间
stories.titleEn: BEAMS HEART Brings Nontan into the Room
stories.zhDeck: 小白猫 Nontan（ノンタン）躺下来睡觉的样子，成为 BEAMS HEART 新系列的起点。11 月 10 日，BEAMS 公布与这套日本绘本的家居服与杂货联名：女装、童装与日用品共 13 款，预定 11 月 27 日在日本门店及官方线上商店发售。双方选择了书里角色入睡的场景，用毛绒、刺绣和贴布做居家服、毯子与玩偶。绘本首作与 BEAMS 创立恰好都在 1976 年，今年各自走到第 50 年。[BEAMS 公告](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5084/) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/beams-heart-nontan/)
stories.enDeck: A collection of roomwear and accessories draws on the picture-book character.
stories.zhMarkdown:
小白猫 Nontan（ノンタン）躺下来睡觉的样子，成为 BEAMS HEART 新系列的起点。11 月 10 日，BEAMS 公布与这套日本绘本的家居服与杂货联名：女装、童装与日用品共 13 款，预定 11 月 27 日在日本门店及官方线上商店发售。双方选择了书里角色入睡的场景，用毛绒、刺绣和贴布做居家服、毯子与玩偶。绘本首作与 BEAMS 创立恰好都在 1976 年，今年各自走到第 50 年。[BEAMS 公告](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5084/) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/beams-heart-nontan/)

这不是把一个卡通形象简单印上衣服。女装长袖与长裤成套 9,900 日元，童装套装 6,050 日元；系列还有开衫、袜子、毛毯、腰部保暖套和毛绒玩偶。选睡眠场景，让形象与产品的使用场所发生关系：书中角色入睡，现实里的人也穿着这些衣物回到家。这里的用途与叙事之间的呼应，是我们对设计的观察，不是品牌关于效果的承诺。[BEAMS 价格与款式](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5084/) · [FASHIONSNAP 款式](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/beams-heart-nontan/)

Nontan 原本甚至不是猫。出版社偕成社回顾，清野幸子最初画的是白色小狐狸，后来听从编辑建议，改成更贴近孩子生活的小猫。1976 年出版的前两本里就包括《Nontan 晚安》；出版社也记录，当年一些大人批评这只小猫不够乖、画风太像漫画。作者在 2006 年访谈中说，她会反复删短文字、读出声音来调整节奏。这个角色从一开始就更接近孩子的玩伴，而不只是一张可爱的图案。[出版社的诞生记录](https://www.kaiseisha.co.jp/special/nontan/story/) · [作者访谈](https://www.bookservice.jp/2018/01/01/post-932/)

今年的 50 周年活动让这种陪伴变成可以走进去的空间。东京 PLAY! MUSEUM 的纪念展已于 9 月结束：展方用秋千、房间和约 50 件原画，让读者在游玩与创作过程之间穿行。当地媒体记录，展览重新呈现了作者的工作桌，也采访了曾负责这一系列的编辑。另一位携女儿观展的作者在 Picoton 记下，两个孩子在《Nontan 的家》体验区停留最久，她自己则被小狐狸原型的原画吸引。这是一家人的现场观察，不能代表所有观众。[PLAY! MUSEUM](https://play2020.jp/article/nontan50/) · [立川现场报道](https://tachikawa-billboard.com/report_list/nontan50) · [Picoton 亲子观展记录](https://workshop.picoton.com/wp_news/2026/08/03/nontan-50th-anniversary-exhibition-play-museum-report/)

2021 年，在高知县立文学馆的另一场 45 周年原画展中，馆方回顾的不只是展期：他们留意到许多成年人也会在画作前驻足，并介绍清野用黑色颜料和墨汁、以细画笔画出粗细不同的轮廓。这个旧展的馆方评论帮助我们看到，绘本里看似轻快的线条同样来自细致的手工；它不提供这次联名的制作证据。[高知县立文学馆评论](https://www.kochi-bungaku.com/7162/)

出版社在今年另一项已结束的读者活动中，与 BEAMS HEART 和玩偶品牌 NICI 合作设计吊饰；《东京新闻》的编辑访谈则谈到，系列里没有大人出来纠正角色，孩子可以进入只属于朋友们的世界。不同活动之间不能直接画等号，但它们共同提示了一条有意思的路径：一本供人朗读的书，可以变成展览里的身体体验，也可以成为回家后继续使用的物件。联名能否让读者重新发现原书，仍取决于人们与作品的实际相遇，而不是商品数量。[出版社读者活动](https://www.kaiseisha.co.jp/special/nontan2026/) · [东京新闻编辑访谈](https://sukusuku.tokyo-np.co.jp/life/115344/) · [互联网博物馆报道](https://www.museum.or.jp/news/126271)

现场报道还记录了展览设计师佐佐木俊为儿童设计的图录：页面使用专色，试图呈现一个人们未见过的 Nontan。展览因此不只放大绘本形象，也重新思考孩子怎样通过纸张、空间和游戏遇见它。[《Illustration》现场报道](https://illustration-mag.jp/news/nontan50th)

这种延伸不只发生在品牌活动中。北海道一位广播员记录，她和孩子根据《Nontan 的生日》里的点心动手做饼干：孩子将画面与食材对照，之后再次读书时仍会谈起这次烘焙。这只是一个家庭的经验，却让绘本如何离开书页、进入家中有了具体的样子。[Sitakke 家庭阅读专栏](https://sitakke.jp/post/17261/)
stories.enMarkdown:
The sight of a small white cat falling asleep is the starting point for a new BEAMS HEART collection. On November 10, BEAMS announced a roomwear and accessories collaboration with the Japanese picture-book series Nontan: thirteen women’s, children’s and home items are scheduled to launch in Japan on November 27. The team draws on sleeping scenes from the books, using soft fleece, embroidery and appliqué on roomwear, blankets and plush toys. Both the first Nontan books and BEAMS date to 1976, making 2026 the fiftieth year for each. [BEAMS announcement](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5084/) · [FASHIONSNAP](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/beams-heart-nontan/)

The collection does more than put a character on a garment. A women’s long-sleeve top and trousers set costs ¥9,900, while the children’s set is ¥6,050; the range also includes a cardigan, socks, a blanket, warmers and a plush toy. The sleeping motif connects the story to the place in which the products are used: the characters rest in the book, and readers can wear the clothes at home. That relationship between narrative and use is our reading of the design, not a claim about its effects. [BEAMS product list](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5084/) · [FASHIONSNAP product report](https://www.fashionsnap.com/article/2026-11-10/beams-heart-nontan/)

Nontan did not begin as a cat. Publisher Kaiseisha recounts that Sachiko Kiyono first drew a white fox, then changed the character to a kitten after an editor suggested an animal closer to children’s everyday lives. The first books published in 1976 included a bedtime story; the publisher also records criticism from some adults who thought Nontan was not well behaved enough or the drawings too much like comics. In a 2006 interview, Kiyono described cutting her text down and reading it aloud repeatedly to find its rhythm. The character was conceived as a companion to children, not merely a decorative image. [Publisher’s history](https://www.kaiseisha.co.jp/special/nontan/story/) · [Creator interview](https://www.bookservice.jp/2018/01/01/post-932/)

This year’s anniversary gave that companionship a physical setting. The fiftieth-anniversary exhibition at Tokyo’s PLAY! MUSEUM closed in September; it paired a swing and recreated rooms with around fifty original illustrations. A local report described a reconstruction of Kiyono’s work desk and spoke with a former editor. A writer who visited with her daughter later described how the two children spent the longest time playing in the Nontan house, while the original drawing of the fox prototype caught her own attention. It is one family’s observation, not evidence of every visitor’s experience. [PLAY! MUSEUM](https://play2020.jp/article/nontan50/) · [Tachikawa report](https://tachikawa-billboard.com/report_list/nontan50) · [Picoton family account](https://workshop.picoton.com/wp_news/2026/08/03/nontan-50th-anniversary-exhibition-play-museum-report/)

Reflecting on a separate 2021 anniversary exhibition at the Kochi Prefectural Literary Museum, a museum writer noticed that many adults also paused before the original drawings. The museum described Kiyono’s dark outlines as made with black pigment mixed with ink, using a fine brush to vary the lines’ thickness. The account makes the apparently effortless illustrations’ handwork visible; it is not evidence of how this new collaboration was manufactured. [Kochi museum commentary](https://www.kochi-bungaku.com/7162/)

In another reader campaign that has already closed, the publisher worked with BEAMS HEART and plush maker NICI on a charm. An interview with the series’ editors in Tokyo Shimbun describes the appeal of a world in which adults do not intervene to correct the characters. These activities are not interchangeable, but together they suggest a path from a book read aloud to an exhibition encountered with the body, and then to objects used at home. Whether the collaboration leads readers back to the original books depends on how people actually encounter the work, not on the number of products released. [Publisher campaign](https://www.kaiseisha.co.jp/special/nontan2026/) · [Tokyo Shimbun interview](https://sukusuku.tokyo-np.co.jp/life/115344/) · [Museum news report](https://www.museum.or.jp/news/126271)

A report from the exhibition preview describes a children’s catalogue designed by Shun Sasaki with spot colours throughout, intended to show a Nontan visitors had not seen before. The exhibition did more than enlarge the character: it reconsidered how children encounter the books through paper, space and play. [Illustration magazine report](https://illustration-mag.jp/news/nontan50th)

The move beyond the page is not confined to branded activities. In a Hokkaido broadcaster’s personal account, she and her children made cookies inspired by Nontan’s birthday book, comparing ingredients and the finished shapes with the illustrations. She says the family talked about baking when they returned to the book. It is one family’s experience, but gives a concrete picture of how a story can enter the home. [Sitakke reading column](https://sitakke.jp/post/17261/)
