stories.titleEn: JJJJound and Danner Return to the Mountain Light
stories.zhDeck: JJJJound 与 Danner 的第三次合作，选了一双原本属于山地的靴子。11 月 4 日，JJJJound 公布两款 Mountain Light：一款黑色全粒面皮革，一款炭灰色磨砂皮；11 月 12 日纽约时间上午 9 点在品牌官网开售，对应北京时间当晚 10 点。品牌把这一版本放进城市日常，却保留了厚实靴型、一整片皮革鞋面、金属鞋带扣和登山靴结构。[JJJJound 项目页](https://www.jjjjound.com/blogs/projects/danner-iii)
stories.enDeck: A third collaboration revisits a boot made for mountain use.
stories.zhMarkdown:
JJJJound 与 Danner 的第三次合作，选了一双原本属于山地的靴子。11 月 4 日，JJJJound 公布两款 Mountain Light：一款黑色全粒面皮革，一款炭灰色磨砂皮；11 月 12 日纽约时间上午 9 点在品牌官网开售，对应北京时间当晚 10 点。品牌把这一版本放进城市日常，却保留了厚实靴型、一整片皮革鞋面、金属鞋带扣和登山靴结构。[JJJJound 项目页](https://www.jjjjound.com/blogs/projects/danner-iii)

两双都采用 GORE-TEX 内衬、Vibram Sierra 外底，以及 Danner 的 stitchdown 缝制结构。黑色款的全粒面皮革来自 Horween，灰色款则为磨砂皮；鞋舌上各有同色系的 JJJJound 织标。品牌称它们在美国由工会工厂制作，并列入可重修设计。这些是产品说明，不能代替对新联名鞋的实际穿着测试。[官方款式与材料](https://www.jjjjound.com/blogs/projects/danner-iii)

这不是双方第一次整理 Mountain Light 的外形。2020 年的首款合作沿用早期靴型纸样，以一整片绒面皮革做鞋面，并加入另一款 Mountain Trail 才有的后跟拉环；品牌当年列出的价格为 400 美元。2021 年的第二次合作又同时带回 Mountain Light 与 Feather Light，材料加入棕色、橄榄色蜡布与绒面皮革。旧款的价格与材料不能直接套用到今年的两双鞋上。[2020 年项目记录](https://www.jjjjound.com/en-ca/blogs/projects/danner) · [2021 年项目记录](https://www.jjjjound.com/blogs/projects/danner-ii)

把皮革做成靴子，需要的不只是决定颜色。Danner 对波特兰工厂的介绍记录了皮料检查、按纸样裁切以及 stitchdown 鞋身与鞋底缝接等工序。另一次由 COOL HUNTING 记者采访工厂样鞋师 Miguel Mayoral 的报道，则写到样鞋不仅要看成品，还要判断材料能否量产，以及未来是否容易拆解维修。另一位 Gear Institute 记者在 2017 年走访波特兰工厂时，也记录了皮革检查、手工缝制以及机械测试如何结合。三份资料分别来自不同时间，都不能视为本次联名鞋逐件制作的现场纪录。[Danner 工厂介绍](https://global.danner.com/factory-tour) · [COOL HUNTING 工厂采访](https://coolhunting.com/design/giving-danner-boots-a-second-life-in-portland-oregon/) · [Gear Institute 2017 年工厂报道](https://gearinstitute.com/profile-danner-boots-a-tradition-of-firsts/)

“可重修”也不是无条件承诺。Danner 的维修说明要求鞋面没有破洞或严重开裂，鞋底边缘还需要保留足够材料供重新缝接；实际是否接受维修，要看具体鞋况和服务范围。把这项条件放在发售细节旁边，比只把它写成一个耐用标签更有用。[Danner 重修说明](https://www.danner.com/recrafting)

经典鞋型的穿着经验也有取舍。《The Great Outdoors》的 Alex Roddie 穿基础款走过山区，认为它磨合后舒适，但价格高、重量大，初期硬皮还曾让他起水泡。RunRepeat 对基础款做过拆解与实验，注意到厚重、磨合期和较少脚底缓冲；Outdoors Magic 的 Athena Mellor 则记录了旧款在湿岩上的抓地感，也提醒长距离徒步者考虑重量。这三组观察针对不同时间的基础款，不能当作对 2026 联名版本的测试结果。[The Great Outdoors](https://www.thegreatoutdoorsmag.com/review/danner-mountain-light/) · [RunRepeat](https://runrepeat.com/danner-mountain-light) · [Outdoors Magic](https://outdoorsmagic.com/article/danner-mountain-light-boot-review/)

JJJJound 最早从网络图像的选择与排列出发。创始人 Justin Saunders 在 Hypebeast 采访里回忆，他把个人博客里的文字去掉，让参考图片以颜色和情绪连续出现。回到这双靴子，变化也集中在皮料、颜色和标识的位置，而没有抹掉原来的厚重结构；至于它能否适合自己的脚和日常路线，仍需要穿上之后判断。[Justin Saunders 采访](https://hypebeast.com/2020/8/jjjjound-justin-saunders-interview-collaborations-new-balance-apc)
stories.enMarkdown:
For their third collaboration, JJJJound and Danner have returned to a boot built for the mountains. On November 4, JJJJound announced two Mountain Light editions: one in black full-grain leather, the other in charcoal nubuck. The release is scheduled for November 12 at 9 a.m. Eastern on JJJJound’s website, or 10 p.m. in Beijing. The brand frames the new versions for everyday city wear while retaining the substantial silhouette, one-piece leather upper, metal hardware and hiking-boot construction. [JJJJound project](https://www.jjjjound.com/blogs/projects/danner-iii)

Both have a GORE-TEX lining, Vibram Sierra outsole and Danner’s stitchdown construction. The black boot uses full-grain leather from Horween; the grey version uses nubuck. Each carries a tonal JJJJound woven tongue label. The brand describes the boots as union-made in the United States and recraftable. These are product specifications, not an independent wear test of this collaboration. [Official specifications](https://www.jjjjound.com/blogs/projects/danner-iii)

The partners have adjusted the Mountain Light before. Their first 2020 edition used an early boot pattern and a one-piece suede upper, adding a heel pull tab borrowed from the Mountain Trail; the brand listed it at $400. In 2021, the second collaboration included both the Mountain Light and Feather Light, with brown and olive waxed canvas and suede among the materials. The earlier prices and construction details should not be assumed to describe the new editions. [2020 project](https://www.jjjjound.com/en-ca/blogs/projects/danner) · [2021 project](https://www.jjjjound.com/blogs/projects/danner-ii)

Turning leather into a boot involves more than choosing a colour. Danner’s account of its Portland factory describes inspecting hides, cutting them to pattern and joining the upper to the sole with stitchdown construction. In a separate COOL HUNTING factory interview, sample maker Miguel Mayoral discussed assessing whether a design can be produced and eventually taken apart for repair. A Gear Institute reporter visiting the Portland factory in 2017 also described leather inspection, hand stitching and mechanical testing. These accounts come from different moments and do not document the production of each new collaborative pair. [Danner factory](https://global.danner.com/factory-tour) · [COOL HUNTING interview](https://coolhunting.com/design/giving-danner-boots-a-second-life-in-portland-oregon/) · [Gear Institute’s 2017 factory visit](https://gearinstitute.com/profile-danner-boots-a-tradition-of-firsts/)

“Recraftable” is not an unconditional promise. Danner’s repair guidance says the leather upper must be free of holes and major cracking, and enough material must remain around the sole for it to be reattached. Acceptance depends on the condition of the individual boots and the service available. Those conditions belong alongside the product description. [Danner recrafting](https://www.danner.com/recrafting)

There are also trade-offs in wearing the established model. The Great Outdoors reviewer Alex Roddie found his standard Mountain Lights comfortable after breaking them in, but noted their cost and weight and described an early blister from stiff leather. RunRepeat’s laboratory review of the regular boot noted its weight, break-in period and minimal underfoot cushioning. Outdoors Magic’s Athena Mellor recorded grip on wet rock in an earlier version while advising long-distance walkers to consider the weight. The three accounts concern different standard editions, not tests of this 2026 collaboration. [The Great Outdoors](https://www.thegreatoutdoorsmag.com/review/danner-mountain-light/) · [RunRepeat](https://runrepeat.com/danner-mountain-light) · [Outdoors Magic](https://outdoorsmagic.com/article/danner-mountain-light-boot-review/)

JJJJound began with the selection and arrangement of images online. In a Hypebeast interview, founder Justin Saunders recalled removing text from a personal blog and letting colour-coordinated references flow together. In these boots, the changes concentrate on leather, colour and the position of the label while the heavy structure remains visible. Whether they suit a particular foot and daily route is something a wearer still has to find out. [Justin Saunders interview](https://hypebeast.com/2020/8/jjjjound-justin-saunders-interview-collaborations-new-balance-apc)

stories.zhDeck: 一个推销员走进陌生酒店，走廊尽头的人说着他听不懂的话。Gentle Monster 为 Intelligent Eyewear 拍摄的预告片，把一副智能眼镜放进这场带着悬念的相遇：短片由 Jonathan Glazer 执导，Joaquin Phoenix 出演，完整影片计划于 11 月公开。品牌宣布 11 月 12 日开始预购，并在纽约安排 11 月 13 日至 23 日的公众预览。[品牌影片公告](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000092.000137182.html)
stories.enDeck: A campaign set in an unfamiliar hotel introduces a new eyewear project.
stories.zhMarkdown:
一个推销员走进陌生酒店，走廊尽头的人说着他听不懂的话。Gentle Monster 为 Intelligent Eyewear 拍摄的预告片，把一副智能眼镜放进这场带着悬念的相遇：短片由 Jonathan Glazer 执导，Joaquin Phoenix 出演，完整影片计划于 11 月公开。品牌宣布 11 月 12 日开始预购，并在纽约安排 11 月 13 日至 23 日的公众预览。[品牌影片公告](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000092.000137182.html)

广告并没有先讲清楚一张参数表。影像评论网站 David Reviews 认为，酒店、光线和人物的迟疑让预告片更像一个尚未解释的谜；《Rolling Stone UK》则注意到，品牌把眼镜作为造型物件来介绍，让观众先看到它如何被佩戴。两种说法都是对预告的解读。真正的翻译或识别效果，还需要等产品可以独立使用后再判断。[David Reviews](https://www.davidreviews.com/News/Jonathan_Glazer_directs_Joaquin_Phoenix_for_Gentle_Monster/) · [Rolling Stone UK](https://www.rollingstone.co.uk/style/gentle-monster-intelligent-eyewear-campaign-short-film-65702/)

这副眼镜由 Gentle Monster、Google 和 Samsung 合作。Google 在 5 月的 I/O 上介绍，首批是以语音反馈为主的眼镜；可在镜片中显示信息的另一类产品属于后续方向。品牌目前展示了不同镜框造型，并介绍翻译、导航和对所见事物提问等计划功能。它称单次充电最长可使用九小时，充电盒可额外充电七次以上；这属于品牌公布的数据，不是我们的续航测试。[Google I/O 介绍](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/android-xr-io-2026/) · [Gentle Monster 产品介绍](https://www.gentlemonster.com/us/en/intelligent-eyewear)

实物的第一批观察同样有限。Android Central 在 7 月活动上拿到了不能运行的样机，记者可以拿在手里，却不能佩戴或测试功能；Tom’s Guide 描述了 Gentle Monster 镜框的外形；其拿起时较轻的感受针对的是 Warby Parker 款。两位记者各自的初步印象可以帮助理解外观，不能替代一天的佩戴体验，更不能据此证明翻译、导航或续航表现。[Android Central 实物观察](https://www.androidcentral.com/wearables/samsung-google-intelligent-eyewear-galaxy-unpacked-2026-hands-on) · [Tom’s Guide 实物观察](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/smart-glasses/i-just-went-hands-on-with-the-new-samsung-smart-glasses-heres-why-id-pick-them-over-meta)

眼镜的可调节性与别人能否察觉摄像头，也是戴上脸之后需要面对的事。TechRadar 在活动中询问 Samsung XR 负责人 James Choi：他表示目前的设备仍依赖手机，也承认镜腿和鼻托的调节受到内部技术结构限制；谈到公共空间里的隐私，他说不同社会环境中的接受程度可能不同。这里记录的是公司代表的回答，而不是对防护效果的独立验证。[TechRadar 现场访谈](https://www.techradar.com/ai-platforms-assistants/we-got-a-first-look-at-samsung-intelligent-eyewear-the-smart-glasses-entering-a-fraught-market-worried-about-privacy)

让技术先进入一个故事，是 Gentle Monster 长期使用的表达方式。《Vogue》2025 年走访首尔 Haus Nowhere 时记录，眼镜陈列与机械雕塑共处；更早的 SPACE 杂志采访中，品牌空间设计负责人 Choi Woosuk 说，团队把空间视为呈现主题和体验的媒介。新影片并不等同于一间店，却延续了让人先接触一个场景、再靠近商品的做法。[Vogue 首尔现场](https://www.vogue.com/article/inside-gentle-monsters-haus-nowhere-the-concept-shop-at-the-center-of-seouls-creative-revolution) · [SPACE 空间设计采访](https://www.vmspace.com/eng/report/report_view.html?base_seq=MTM5OA%3D%3D)

时间上要把预购与交付分开。VR.org 对品牌美国页面和公开信息的梳理指出，11 月 12 日是预购日期，系列计划 12 月推出；它当时没有找到价格，也没有确认韩国交付日期。品牌预告提供了一种对未来日常的想象，而一副真正戴得舒服、让佩戴者和周围人都明白何时在拍摄的眼镜，还要在使用中接受检验。[VR.org 发布信息核查](https://vr.org/articles/gentle-monster-december-launch-preorder-november-12-android-xr-glasses-2026)
stories.enMarkdown:
A salesman enters an unfamiliar hotel and encounters people whose words he cannot understand. Gentle Monster’s teaser for Intelligent Eyewear places a pair of smart glasses inside that encounter. Directed by Jonathan Glazer and starring Joaquin Phoenix, the full campaign film is due in November. The brand says pre-orders begin November 12, with a public preview in New York from November 13 to 23. [Campaign announcement](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000092.000137182.html)

The teaser does not begin with a specification sheet. Advertising publication David Reviews sees the lighting, hotel and hesitant character as an unresolved mystery; *Rolling Stone UK* notices how the eyewear is introduced as something one might choose to wear. These are readings of a preview. How well the glasses actually translate or recognise a scene remains a question for independent use. [David Reviews](https://www.davidreviews.com/News/Jonathan_Glazer_directs_Joaquin_Phoenix_for_Gentle_Monster/) · [Rolling Stone UK](https://www.rollingstone.co.uk/style/gentle-monster-intelligent-eyewear-campaign-short-film-65702/)

Gentle Monster, Google and Samsung developed the eyewear together. At Google I/O in May, Google described the first generation as audio glasses, with display glasses as a separate future direction. Gentle Monster has shown several frame shapes and lists planned translation, navigation and visual-question functions. It states up to nine hours on a charge and seven or more additional charges from the case. Those are the brand’s figures, not our battery test. [Google I/O](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/android-xr-io-2026/) · [Gentle Monster product information](https://www.gentlemonster.com/us/en/intelligent-eyewear)

Early observations of the physical object also have limits. At a July event, an Android Central reporter could hold non-functioning models but was not allowed to wear or operate them; Tom’s Guide described the Gentle Monster frames; the model its reporter found light when picked up was the Warby Parker version. Their separate impressions help explain the appearance, but do not establish all-day comfort or the performance of translation, navigation or battery life. [Android Central first look](https://www.androidcentral.com/wearables/samsung-google-intelligent-eyewear-galaxy-unpacked-2026-hands-on) · [Tom’s Guide first look](https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/smart-glasses/i-just-went-hands-on-with-the-new-samsung-smart-glasses-heres-why-id-pick-them-over-meta)

Fit and the visibility of a camera matter once a device is worn on the face. At the event, TechRadar asked Samsung XR executive James Choi about the design. He said the glasses still depend on a phone and acknowledged that technology in the frame limits adjustments to the arms and nose bridge. He also discussed how public acceptance of camera eyewear may differ across social settings. These are a company representative’s answers, not an independent verification of the safeguards. [TechRadar interview](https://www.techradar.com/ai-platforms-assistants/we-got-a-first-look-at-samsung-intelligent-eyewear-the-smart-glasses-entering-a-fraught-market-worried-about-privacy)

Introducing a product through a story is familiar territory for Gentle Monster. Visiting Seoul’s Haus Nowhere in 2025, *Vogue* described eyewear displays alongside kinetic sculptures. In an earlier SPACE magazine interview, the brand’s spatial design head Choi Woosuk described using space as a medium for themes and experiences. A film and a shop are different settings, but each lets the viewer encounter an environment before approaching the object. [Vogue in Seoul](https://www.vogue.com/article/inside-gentle-monsters-haus-nowhere-the-concept-shop-at-the-center-of-seouls-creative-revolution) · [SPACE design interview](https://www.vmspace.com/eng/report/report_view.html?base_seq=MTM5OA%3D%3D)

Pre-order and delivery are separate dates. Reviewing the brand’s US page and public announcements, VR.org reported November 12 as the pre-order opening and December as the planned release; it had not found a price or confirmed a Korean delivery date. The teaser imagines a future everyday encounter. Whether these glasses are comfortable to wear, and whether wearers and bystanders can tell when recording is taking place, will need to be assessed through actual use. [VR.org release reporting](https://vr.org/articles/gentle-monster-december-launch-preorder-november-12-android-xr-glasses-2026)

stories.title: 奥姬芙与她的同代人：一场美国现代主义展览
stories.titleEn: Georgia O’Keeffe and Her Modernist Contemporaries
stories.zhDeck: 一张画布里，蓝、绿与黑色的色带相互挤压，浅色形状沿着画面向外流动。它是 Georgia O’Keeffe 的《Blue and Green Music》（1919—1921），也是韩国国立现代美术馆果川馆《Georgia O’Keeffe and American Modernism》的展品之一。展览将于 11 月 12 日对公众开放，持续至 2027 年 3 月 21 日；馆方列出共 107 件作品，借此讲述奥姬芙与美国现代主义艺术家的关系。[韩国国立现代美术馆](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [作品研究档案](https://access-ok.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8445/)
stories.enDeck: An exhibition in Korea places O’Keeffe among other American modernists.
stories.zhMarkdown:
一张画布里，蓝、绿与黑色的色带相互挤压，浅色形状沿着画面向外流动。它是 Georgia O’Keeffe 的《Blue and Green Music》（1919—1921），也是韩国国立现代美术馆果川馆《Georgia O’Keeffe and American Modernism》的展品之一。展览将于 11 月 12 日对公众开放，持续至 2027 年 3 月 21 日；馆方列出共 107 件作品，借此讲述奥姬芙与美国现代主义艺术家的关系。[韩国国立现代美术馆](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [作品研究档案](https://access-ok.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8445/)

画面没有明确描绘一首乐曲、一个演奏者或一处风景。奥姬芙美术馆的作品档案描述了其中向上延伸的蓝绿线条与起伏的浅色形状；韩国馆的导览则把这幅画放进艺术家与音乐、色彩和抽象的讨论中。标题里的“音乐”给观看提供了方向，却不必要求每个人在画里找到同一段旋律。[奥姬芙美术馆作品档案](https://access-ok.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8445/) · [韩国馆展览与导览](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095)

这次展览不只有绘画。馆方介绍，作品以芝加哥艺术博物馆的 Alfred Stieglitz 收藏为中心，包含 Arthur Dove、Marsden Hartley、Charles Demuth 的作品，也有 Paul Strand 和 Edward Weston 的摄影。Stieglitz 既是摄影师，也是经营画廊、组织展览的参与者；大都会艺术博物馆 2011 年回顾他的收藏时，将美国艺术家与 Picasso、Matisse 等欧洲艺术家的作品放在同一条展览史里。[韩国馆](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [大都会艺术博物馆旧展](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions/listings/2011/stieglitz-and-his-artists-matisse-to-okeeffe)

摄影与绘画之间并不是单向影响。惠特尼美术馆 2009 年《Abstraction》展览的导览讲到，奥姬芙在暗房帮助冲印 Stieglitz 的照片，也由此接触到通过裁切与放大让具象图像变得抽象的方法。美国国家美术馆对 Stieglitz 云朵摄影的研究则指出，他在 1920 年代先以音乐为部分系列命名，后来使用《Equivalents》来描述它们与个人感受之间的关系。这些旧展和研究是理解艺术家之间对话的背景，并非果川展的现场记录。[惠特尼展览导览](https://whitney.org/guides/4) · [美国国家美术馆研究](https://www.nga.gov/research/publications/alfred-stieglitz-key-set/about-alfred-stieglitz-career-overview)

展览导览还列出 John Marin 的《Woolworth Building (The Dance)》（1913）。费城艺术博物馆对自己所藏版本的说明记载，Marin 反复描绘这座纽约摩天楼，试图在版画中表现建筑及城市的力量。不同机构可能收藏同一版画的不同版本，因此费城的对象档案用来解释作品背景，不能直接等同于韩国展出版本。[韩国馆导览](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [费城艺术博物馆](https://www.philamuseum.org/objects/50646)

Paul Strand 的《Driftwood》（1928）也在韩国馆导览之列。费城艺术博物馆为其 2014 年摄影回顾展整理的时间线记录，Strand 在 1927—1928 年前往缅因州海岸，用相机研究漂木、岩石、植物与森林。自然物在他的镜头里并不只是风景背景，它们的纹理和形状本身成为观看对象。[韩国馆](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [Paul Strand 回顾展](https://www.philamuseum.org/exhibitions/paul-strand-master-of-modern-photography)

奥姬芙的《Cow’s Skull with Calico Roses》（1931）把白色牛骨与两朵白色布玫瑰放在一起。她的作品研究档案记录，这幅画早在 1931—1932 年便出现在纽约 An American Place 的展览照片中，后来进入芝加哥收藏；馆方 2025 年保存记录还说明了画布、颜料和未上清漆的表面。现在它将与其他作品一起来到果川，而不是单独作为一张可辨认的图像出现。[韩国馆](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [作品档案与保存记录](https://access-ok.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8787/)

这批收藏也有复杂的机构历史。美国国家美术馆关于 Duncan Phillips 的研究记录，Stieglitz 1946 年去世后，奥姬芙与多家机构讨论作品的去向；1949 年的捐赠分布到包括芝加哥、大都会和费城在内的不同机构。另一边，底特律艺术博物馆今年从纽约城市景观、乡村建筑和新墨西哥州居所切入，展示奥姬芙对建筑持续多年的兴趣；《Wallpaper*》则从该展观察她怎样描绘所居住的空间。底特律展与果川展各有自己的选件，但共同提醒我们，一位艺术家的作品需要放在地点、人和收藏流转之中慢慢看。[美国国家美术馆研究](https://www.nga.gov/research/publications/american-paintings-1900-1945/duncan-phillips) · [底特律展览资料](https://dia.org/about/media-room/news/detroit-institute-arts-presents-georgia-okeeffe-architecture-groundbreaking) · [Wallpaper* 观察](https://www.wallpaper.com/art/exhibitions-shows/georgia-okeeffe-architecture-detroit-institute-of-arts)
stories.enMarkdown:
Bands of blue, green and black press against one another on a canvas, while lighter forms move across it. Georgia O’Keeffe’s *Blue and Green Music* (1919–1921) is among the works listed for *Georgia O’Keeffe and American Modernism* at the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art’s Gwacheon branch in Korea. Opening to the public on November 12 and running through March 21, 2027, the exhibition lists 107 works and situates O’Keeffe among artists associated with American modernism. [MMCA](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [Object research record](https://access-ok.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8445/)

The picture does not clearly depict a particular composition, musician or landscape. The Georgia O’Keeffe Museum’s object record describes the rising blue and green bands and the pale undulating forms; the Korean museum’s guide places the painting within a discussion of music, colour and abstraction. “Music” gives a way into the work without requiring every viewer to find the same melody. [O’Keeffe Museum record](https://access-ok.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8445/) · [MMCA exhibition and guide](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095)

The exhibition includes more than painting. Built around the Art Institute of Chicago’s Alfred Stieglitz Collection, it brings together works by Arthur Dove, Marsden Hartley and Charles Demuth alongside photographs by Paul Strand and Edward Weston, according to MMCA. Stieglitz was both a photographer and a participant who ran galleries and organised exhibitions. In its 2011 survey of his collection, the Metropolitan Museum placed American artists alongside European figures including Picasso and Matisse within the history of his exhibitions. [MMCA](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [Metropolitan Museum exhibition](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions/listings/2011/stieglitz-and-his-artists-matisse-to-okeeffe)

The relationship between photography and painting was not one-directional. The Whitney Museum’s guide to its 2009 *Abstraction* exhibition describes O’Keeffe helping print Stieglitz’s photographs in the darkroom and encountering the ways cropping and magnification can make a representational image abstract. The National Gallery of Art’s research on Stieglitz’s cloud photographs notes that he used musical titles for some early sequences before calling them *Equivalents*, connecting them to his own thoughts and feelings. These earlier sources offer context; they are not accounts of the Gwacheon installation. [Whitney guide](https://whitney.org/guides/4) · [National Gallery research](https://www.nga.gov/research/publications/alfred-stieglitz-key-set/about-alfred-stieglitz-career-overview)

The Korean guide also lists John Marin’s *Woolworth Building (The Dance)* (1913). Discussing its own impression, the Philadelphia Museum of Art describes Marin returning repeatedly to the New York skyscraper in an effort to convey the forces of the building and the city through printmaking. Different institutions may hold different impressions of a print, so Philadelphia’s object account supplies context and should not be treated as the identical impression shown in Korea. [MMCA guide](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [Philadelphia Museum of Art](https://www.philamuseum.org/objects/50646)

Paul Strand’s *Driftwood* (1928) also appears in the Korean museum’s guide. A timeline for Philadelphia’s 2014 Strand retrospective records his trips to the Maine coast in 1927–1928, when he used a camera to study driftwood, rocks, plants and forests. Natural objects were not merely scenery in those photographs: their surfaces and shapes became subjects in their own right. [MMCA](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [Paul Strand retrospective](https://www.philamuseum.org/exhibitions/paul-strand-master-of-modern-photography)

O’Keeffe’s *Cow’s Skull with Calico Roses* (1931) places a white skull alongside two white fabric roses. Her catalogue record notes the painting’s appearance in a 1931–1932 exhibition photograph at New York’s An American Place, before it entered the Chicago collection. A 2025 conservation entry also records its canvas, paint and unvarnished surface. It is now listed alongside other works for Gwacheon, rather than as an isolated familiar image. [MMCA](https://www.mmca.go.kr/eng/exhibitions/exhibitionsDetail.do?exhFlag=2&exhId=202609220002095) · [Object and conservation record](https://access-ok.okeeffemuseum.org/object/8787/)

The collection has an institutional history of its own. National Gallery research on Duncan Phillips describes O’Keeffe’s discussions with several museums after Stieglitz’s death in 1946; gifts announced in 1949 were distributed among institutions including Chicago, the Met and Philadelphia. Meanwhile, a Detroit Institute of Arts exhibition this year considers her sustained interest in architecture through New York cityscapes, rural buildings and her New Mexico homes. *Wallpaper* observes how she pictured the spaces she inhabited. The Detroit and Gwacheon shows have different selections, but together they invite viewers to consider an artist’s work through places, people and the movement of collections. [National Gallery research](https://www.nga.gov/research/publications/american-paintings-1900-1945/duncan-phillips) · [Detroit exhibition](https://dia.org/about/media-room/news/detroit-institute-arts-presents-georgia-okeeffe-architecture-groundbreaking) · [Wallpaper review](https://www.wallpaper.com/art/exhibitions-shows/georgia-okeeffe-architecture-detroit-institute-of-arts)

stories.zhDeck: 一顶宽檐帽、一件皮夹克，以及背后的 10 号：Kith 今年为纽约尼克斯制作的系列，把主角交给了 Walt“Clyde”Frazier。11 月 9 日的品牌公告列出一组以这位名人堂球员为中心的服饰，包括与 AVIREX 合作的皮革飞行夹克、网眼上衣、可翻面的衬衫、拉链卫衣和手工摇头玩偶。Frazier 本人也出现在宣传画面里。[Kith](https://kith.com/) · [系列报道](https://www.justfresh.co/fashion/kith-new-york-knicks-2026-walt-frazier-collection)

stories.zhMarkdown:
一顶宽檐帽、一件皮夹克，以及背后的 10 号：Kith 今年为纽约尼克斯制作的系列，把主角交给了 Walt“Clyde”Frazier。11 月 9 日的品牌公告列出一组以这位名人堂球员为中心的服饰，包括与 AVIREX 合作的皮革飞行夹克、网眼上衣、可翻面的衬衫、拉链卫衣和手工摇头玩偶。Frazier 本人也出现在宣传画面里。[Kith](https://kith.com/) · [系列报道](https://www.justfresh.co/fashion/kith-new-york-knicks-2026-walt-frazier-collection)

系列将于 11 月 13 日在纽约、伦敦、巴黎和东京按当地上午 11 点发售；纽约时间对应北京时间 11 月 14 日零点。麦迪逊广场花园的提前快闪安排在纽约当地 11 月 10 日，时间已经过去。商品还包括另一件带有设计师 Michael Doret 图案的飞行夹克、人字纹西装、Wilson 迷你篮筐、宠物配件和家居用品。价格与各地区库存仍以实际发布为准。 JustFresh 把家居小物与皮夹克并置，读作球队文化进入不同消费者的日常；这是报道的观察，不是对销售表现的证据。[Kith](https://kith.com/) · [JustFresh](https://www.justfresh.co/fashion/kith-new-york-knicks-2026-walt-frazier-collection)

这是一段持续多年的球队与品牌合作。Kith 的 2022 年说明记录，双方在 2020 年推出首个联名服饰系列，品牌创始人 Ronnie Fieg 后来成为尼克斯首位创意总监。过去的球队球衣、球场和街头服饰都进入过合作范围；今年选择 Frazier，则把镜头拉到一个早已在球场之外建立辨识度的人身上。[Kith 品牌资料](https://kith.com/) · [Vogue 合作背景](https://www.vogue.com/article/the-business-of-the-new-york-knicks)

“Clyde”这个名字和一顶帽子有关。Frazier 在 2013 年接受 GQ 采访时回忆，他在巴尔的摩看到一顶当时并不流行的宽檐帽，虽然队友和对手起初都笑他，他仍然继续戴。电影《Bonnie and Clyde》上映后，外形与球场上的抢断共同促成了这个称呼。这是他多年后回忆自己的故事，而不是说这次 Kith 的每一件衣服都直接复刻了那顶帽子。[GQ 采访](https://www.gq.com/story/nba-fashion-style-walt-clyde-frazier-interview)

Frazier 的衣服不是只靠醒目的颜色。2016 年他告诉 GQ，自己为裁缝挑选面料和剪裁，包括不同领型；2018 年在 Andscape 的另一次采访里，他描述休赛期走进纽约布料店、把样布带回家，再为外套搭配领带与衬衫。2026 年的 Vogue 报道则写到，纽约布料店 Beckenstein 为他制作总决赛期间穿着的西装，曾拿家具面料供他挑选。三次记录来自不同年份，看到的是同一种持续的个人实践。[GQ 2016](https://www.gq.com/story/walt-clyde-frazier-puma-sneakers-style) · [Andscape](https://andscape.com/features/new-york-knicks-walt-frazier-hall-of-fame-career-his-suit-game/) · [Vogue](https://www.vogue.com/article/knicks-legend-walt-clyde-fraziers-suits-are-amazing-and-made-in-new-york)

球场、服饰与表达早就一起出现在他的工作里。Vanity Fair 在 2011 年访谈中谈到他与 Ira Berkow 合写的 1974 年《Rockin’ Steady》，书里并置篮球技巧、生活经验和穿着；在 Nice Kicks 2014 年的采访中，Frazier 也回忆 PUMA Clyde 球鞋把他的名字带到了球场内外。这些旧作品提供人物背景，和今天的 Kith 系列是不同合作。[Vanity Fair](https://www.vanityfair.com/culture/2011/02/qa-walt-frazier-on-the-knicks-and-nba-style) · [Nice Kicks](https://www.nicekicks.com/interview-walt-frazier-talks-fashion-enduring-legacy-of-the-puma-clyde/)

新系列的另一条线索是队徽设计。Fast Company 采访 Michael Doret 时回顾，1992 年推出的尼克斯标志把粗体队名、篮球和倒三角放在一起；纽约媒体 NY1 的采访记录了他先前手绘草图，以及未被采用的帝国大厦构想。今年由他参与图案的夹克、Frazier 的 10 号，以及能摆在家里的小篮筐，共同把球队记忆放进不同的生活场景。[Fast Company](https://www.fastcompany.com/91551682/new-york-knicks-logo) · [NY1](https://ny1.com/nyc/all-boroughs/news/2026/06/08/meet-the-artist-who-designed-the-knicks-logo-michael-doret)

A wide-brimmed hat, a leather jacket and the number 10 on the back: Kith’s latest New York Knicks collection puts Walt “Clyde” Frazier at its centre. The brand’s November 9 announcement describes a capsule dedicated to the Hall of Fame player, including a Kith and AVIREX leather bomber, mesh shirts, a reversible shirt, a zip hoodie and a handcrafted bobblehead. Frazier also appears in the campaign. [Kith](https://kith.com/) · [Collection report](https://www.justfresh.co/fashion/kith-new-york-knicks-2026-walt-frazier-collection)

The collection is scheduled for November 13 at 11 a.m. local time in New York, London, Paris and Tokyo; New York’s time is midnight on November 14 in Beijing. An early pop-up at Madison Square Garden was scheduled for November 10 in New York and has already passed. The wider range includes another aviator jacket with artwork by Michael Doret, a herringbone suit, a Wilson mini hoop, pet accessories and home goods. Prices and regional availability remain subject to the actual release. JustFresh reads the range of home goods alongside leather jackets as a way for team culture to enter different customers’ daily lives; that is the publication’s interpretation, not evidence of sales. [Kith](https://kith.com/) · [JustFresh](https://www.justfresh.co/fashion/kith-new-york-knicks-2026-walt-frazier-collection)

The team and the brand have worked together for several years. Kith’s 2022 account records their first collaborative apparel collection in 2020 and the later appointment of founder Ronnie Fieg as the Knicks’ first creative director. Past collaborations have included team uniforms, a court and clothes; choosing Frazier now brings in someone whose identity extended well beyond the court. [Kith background](https://kith.com/) · [Vogue report](https://www.vogue.com/article/the-business-of-the-new-york-knicks)

The name “Clyde” is tied to a hat. In a 2013 GQ interview, Frazier recalled spotting a wide-brimmed style in Baltimore when narrow brims were common. Teammates and opponents initially laughed, he said, but he kept wearing it. After *Bonnie and Clyde* came out, the look and his ability to steal the ball contributed to the nickname. This is Frazier’s later recollection, not a claim that every piece in the new Kith range directly reproduces that hat. [GQ interview](https://www.gq.com/story/nba-fashion-style-walt-clyde-frazier-interview)

His clothes involve more than conspicuous colour. In 2016 he told GQ that he chose fabrics and cuts for his tailor, including different lapels. In a separate 2018 Andscape interview, he described walking through New York fabric shops in the off-season, taking swatches home and choosing ties and shirts to accompany a jacket. Vogue’s 2026 report describes Beckenstein making suits for him during the Finals, including showing him upholstery fabrics. The accounts come from different years and trace a continuing personal practice. [GQ, 2016](https://www.gq.com/story/walt-clyde-frazier-puma-sneakers-style) · [Andscape](https://andscape.com/features/new-york-knicks-walt-frazier-hall-of-fame-career-his-suit-game/) · [Vogue](https://www.vogue.com/article/knicks-legend-walt-clyde-fraziers-suits-are-amazing-and-made-in-new-york)

Sport, clothing and self-expression have long met in his work. A 2011 Vanity Fair interview discussed *Rockin’ Steady*, his 1974 book with Ira Berkow, which brought together basketball instruction, personal stories and dress. In a 2014 Nice Kicks interview, Frazier also recalled how the PUMA Clyde carried his name on and off the court. These are earlier projects, distinct from the present Kith collection. [Vanity Fair](https://www.vanityfair.com/culture/2011/02/qa-walt-frazier-on-the-knicks-and-nba-style) · [Nice Kicks](https://www.nicekicks.com/interview-walt-frazier-talks-fashion-enduring-legacy-of-the-puma-clyde/)

The team’s graphic identity provides another thread. Fast Company’s interview with Michael Doret traces the Knicks logo unveiled in 1992, combining the team name, a basketball and an inverted triangle. A separate NY1 interview describes his hand-drawn proposals, including an Empire State Building concept that was not selected. A jacket with his artwork, Frazier’s number 10 and a mini hoop for the home carry different parts of the team’s history into everyday life. [Fast Company](https://www.fastcompany.com/91551682/new-york-knicks-logo) · [NY1](https://ny1.com/nyc/all-boroughs/news/2026/06/08/meet-the-artist-who-designed-the-knicks-logo-michael-doret)

stories.title: 胡昀《量化池》：当植物被看作一座矿
stories.titleEn: Hu Yun’s Quantified Self: When Plants Become a Resource

stories.zhMarkdown:
一株能吸收镍的植物，在艺术家眼里既是植物，也可能被人看作资源。胡昀个展《量化池》11 月 11 日在上海阿拉里奥画廊开幕，展期至 2027 年 1 月 2 日。展览从艺术家在奥赫里德湖畔遇到的超富集植物出发，连接金属浮雕、手工织毯、玻璃雕塑和刺绣，追问人们如何通过测量重新给生命赋值。以下关于本次展览的作品与布置来自画廊说明，不是我们的现场观察。[阿拉里奥展览说明](https://www.arariogallery.com/ko/exhibitions/384-hu-yun-quantified-self-solo-exhibition/)

《自然万物，只是生长》（2026）将 2025 年研究途中收集的植物标本翻模，经过电铸制成铜板，再覆以镍层。画廊说，作品按植物标本的标准尺寸切割，并用模拟日光的植物生长灯照亮。原本活着的植物被制作成可归档、可比较的物件；观众面对的既是植物形态，也是人决定如何保存它的一套方法。[画廊作品说明](https://www.arariogallery.com/ko/exhibitions/384-hu-yun-quantified-self-solo-exhibition/)

超富集植物确实是科学研究的对象，但它们并不是一个自动解决污染的万能答案。昆士兰大学研究者介绍，植物采矿涉及从植物组织中回收它所吸收的金属；曾与胡昀合作的植物科学家 Antony van der Ent 等人在 2024 年的论文中提醒，研究者必须谨慎区分自然环境下真正的超富集现象与实验条件下的积累。展览把这种研究带入关于价值和劳动的讨论，不等于宣告某个具体修复项目已经成功。[昆士兰大学研究说明](https://smi.uq.edu.au/article/2019/07/australian-plants-extracting-high-value-metals-mining-wastes) · [2024 年研究论文](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11221517/)

这并不是胡昀第一次与这位科学家合作。昆士兰美术馆的策展文章介绍，他为 2021 年第十届亚太当代艺术三年展制作的《It is not mine to give, nor yours to take》由两幅长卷组成：一幅画超富集植物，另一幅使用 van der Ent 根据 X 射线成像制作的元素分布图。艺术家同时研究澳大利亚金矿地区华人劳动者姓名在英文记录中的变化，把植物、矿物与迁徙史并置。澳中关系基金会对艺术家的采访也谈到这两幅卷轴分别采用的绘画和科学图像。[QAGOMA 策展文章](https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/stories/hu-yun-two-scrolls-bring-together-science-art-and-nature-apt10/) · [澳中关系基金会采访](https://www.australiachinafoundation.org.au/zh-hans/news/tingxiasikaoganshougaibianwomenruhekandaiyataideyishuzhan)

新展中的羊毛挂毯《无题（原子）》（2026）延续了这条线索。画廊介绍，巴尔干的一间手织工坊将超富集植物细胞的同步辐射扫描图像转成织物纹样。图像经过科学设备、艺术家与织工的不同处理，最终成为一件有重量和纤维纹理的物品。画廊将织机打孔卡的历史与数字图像联系起来；这是一条策展解读，而不是说挂毯就是数据本身。[阿拉里奥展览说明](https://www.arariogallery.com/ko/exhibitions/384-hu-yun-quantified-self-solo-exhibition/)

另一件玻璃雕塑《刻水融石》（2021）与胡昀为 2019 年新加坡双年展制作的同名项目有关。双年展策展人 Patrick Flores 的文章介绍，艺术家曾研究菲律宾帕埃特的木雕与从新加坡国家博物馆移出的历史透视模型。上海画廊则说明，本次玻璃作品以木雕残肢为模型，将类似冰块的透明形体固定下来；2019 年项目和 2021 年玻璃作品有联系，但媒介与年份不同。[Patrick Flores 论新加坡双年展](https://passjournal.org/patrick-flores-singapore-biennale-2019/) · [阿拉里奥展览说明](https://www.arariogallery.com/ko/exhibitions/384-hu-yun-quantified-self-solo-exhibition/)

棕榈叶是胡昀持续描绘的另一种植物。2024 年上海外滩美术馆展览的现场报道指出，他对棕榈的兴趣涉及植物随殖民、贸易和全球化流动的历史。《Frieze》评论者 Jennifer Piejko 在看过那场展览后，注意到他如何利用博物馆原有的标本柜和遮蔽物，使观众重新思考知识怎样被分类。另一篇 ArtAsiaPacific 评论则认为，作品的暧昧与不透明也可能让一些观众感到难以进入。两篇评论讨论的是过去的《远山》，并不替今天的新展下结论。[City News Service](https://www.citynewsservice.cn/articles/cns/lifestyle/chinese-journal-project-showing-at-rockbund-art-museum-pk8r79jm) · [Frieze 旧展评论](https://www.frieze.com/article/hu-yun-mount-analogue-2024-review) · [ArtAsiaPacific 评论作者页面](https://linggu.org/2024/06/28/shanghai-hu-yun-mount-analogue/)

胡昀在两次不同采访中分别谈到伦敦自然历史博物馆的研究经历，以及植物和人的迁移如何进入自己的创作。眼下《量化池》把材料推得更具体：纸上的植物、镀镍的植物、扫描后的植物和织成纹样的植物，分别被放进不同的工作流程里。它们看上去属于同一主题，却让人看到每一步有谁在采集、制作、命名，以及谁来决定它的价值。[ArtReview 采访转载](https://www.trueart.com/news/719625.html) · [artnow 采访转载](https://www.trueart.com/news/712972.html)
stories.enMarkdown:
A plant that absorbs nickel is a plant, but it may also become a resource in someone else’s account. Hu Yun’s *Quantified Self* opens at Arario Gallery Shanghai on November 11 and runs through January 2, 2027. Beginning with hyperaccumulator plants encountered near Lake Ohrid, the exhibition brings together metal reliefs, a handwoven tapestry, glass sculpture and embroidery to ask how measurement changes the value assigned to life. The descriptions of the current installation below come from the gallery; we have not visited it. [Arario exhibition](https://www.arariogallery.com/ko/exhibitions/384-hu-yun-quantified-self-solo-exhibition/)

*Things in Nature Merely Grow* (2026) begins with specimens collected during a 2025 research trip. They were moulded, formed into copper plates through electroforming and coated in nickel. The gallery says the plates were cut to standard botanical-specimen dimensions and lit with indoor grow lights that simulate sunlight. Living forms become objects that can be archived and compared; viewers encounter both the plant’s shape and a method people use to preserve it. [Gallery account](https://www.arariogallery.com/ko/exhibitions/384-hu-yun-quantified-self-solo-exhibition/)

Hyperaccumulator plants are real subjects of scientific research, but they are not an automatic cure for pollution. University of Queensland researchers describe phytomining as the recovery of metals held in plant tissue. In a 2024 paper, plant scientist Antony van der Ent, who has collaborated with Hu, and co-author Elizabeth Rylott caution researchers to distinguish genuine accumulation in a natural habitat from results produced under experimental conditions. The exhibition moves this research into a discussion of value and labour; it does not establish that a particular remediation project has succeeded. [University of Queensland](https://smi.uq.edu.au/article/2019/07/australian-plants-extracting-high-value-metals-mining-wastes) · [2024 research paper](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11221517/)

Hu had worked with the scientist before. A Queensland Art Gallery curatorial essay describes *It is not mine to give, nor yours to take*, commissioned for the 10th Asia Pacific Triennial in 2021, as two long scrolls. One depicts hyperaccumulator plants; the other uses elemental maps produced from X-ray imaging by van der Ent. Hu also researched variations in English-language records of Chinese workers’ names in Australia’s goldfields, placing plants, minerals and migration histories beside one another. An interview published by the National Foundation for Australia-China Relations discusses the two scrolls’ different visual methods. [QAGOMA essay](https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/stories/hu-yun-two-scrolls-bring-together-science-art-and-nature-apt10/) · [Foundation interview](https://www.australiachinafoundation.org.au/zh-hans/news/tingxiasikaoganshougaibianwomenruhekandaiyataideyishuzhan)

The new wool tapestry *Untitled (Atom)* (2026) continues that line of research. Arario says a handweaving workshop in the Balkans translated synchrotron scans of hyperaccumulator cells into a textile pattern. Scientific equipment, the artist and weavers each handle the image before it becomes an object with weight and fibres. The gallery connects the history of punched cards in weaving to digital images; that is a curatorial reading, not a claim that the tapestry is raw data. [Arario exhibition](https://www.arariogallery.com/ko/exhibitions/384-hu-yun-quantified-self-solo-exhibition/)

The glass sculpture *Carving Water, Melting Stones* (2021) relates to a similarly titled project commissioned for the 2019 Singapore Biennale. In an essay about the biennale, curator Patrick Flores describes Hu’s research into woodcarving in Paete, the Philippines, and historical dioramas removed from the National Museum of Singapore. Arario says the glass work in Shanghai takes a fragment of a wooden carving as its model, fixing a transparent form resembling ice. The 2019 project and 2021 sculpture are related, but their media and dates differ. [Patrick Flores on the biennale](https://passjournal.org/patrick-flores-singapore-biennale-2019/) · [Arario account](https://www.arariogallery.com/ko/exhibitions/384-hu-yun-quantified-self-solo-exhibition/)

Palm leaves are another recurring subject. A report on Hu’s 2024 exhibition at the Rockbund Art Museum describes his interest in the movement of palms through colonial, trading and global histories. Reviewing that exhibition, *Frieze* critic Jennifer Piejko considered how the artist used the museum’s old specimen cabinets and coverings to question the classification of knowledge. An ArtAsiaPacific review suggested that the works’ ambiguity could also make them difficult for some viewers to enter. Both reviews concern the earlier *Mount Analogue* and do not stand in for a judgment of the new show. [City News Service](https://www.citynewsservice.cn/articles/cns/lifestyle/chinese-journal-project-showing-at-rockbund-art-museum-pk8r79jm) · [Frieze review](https://www.frieze.com/article/hu-yun-mount-analogue-2024-review) · [ArtAsiaPacific review on the author’s site](https://linggu.org/2024/06/28/shanghai-hu-yun-mount-analogue/)

In two separate interviews, Hu discussed research at London’s Natural History Museum and the ways the movement of plants and people enters his practice. *Quantified Self* gives those questions material form: a plant drawn on paper, a plant plated in nickel, a plant scanned and a plant translated into woven pattern move through different kinds of work. Each stage makes visible decisions about who collects, makes and names—and who decides what has value. [ArtReview interview, republished](https://www.trueart.com/news/719625.html) · [artnow interview, republished](https://www.trueart.com/news/712972.html)

NEEDLES 和 BEAMS BOY 这次做了一套可以自由拆开的运动服：上衣三色、裤子三色，六种底色各不相同。BEAMS 公告显示，两件别注将于 11 月 12 日在日本部分门店和官网发售。新开发的 Hijideru 圆领上衣含税 23,100 日元，H.D. 轮廓长裤含税 31,900 日元；上衣使用柔软的聚酯针织，裤子换成有光泽的丝绒。[BEAMS 公告](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5066/)

配色的出发点是美国大学的校色，但它没有把校徽简单搬上衣服。BEAMS BOY 重新组合了衣身、侧条与蝴蝶刺绣的颜色：上衣为浅灰、炭灰和橄榄绿，裤子为黑、棕和海军蓝。可以穿成一套，也可以把不同颜色分开搭配。JustFresh 11 月 1 日曾观察到六色都可在线预订；这一观察不是今天的库存保证，实际尺码和现货仍需看商品页面。[官方款式与售价](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5066/) · [TIDEZINE 造型分析](https://tidezine.com/en/news/needles-beams-boy-ivy-hijideru-hd-track-2026) · [JustFresh 的预订观察](https://www.justfresh.co/fashion/needles-beams-boy-track-series-november-12)

这件圆领上衣从 H.D. 裤型得到启发。日本选物店 ARZACH 在比较多种 H.D. 裤款时解释，腰部与裤脚的省道让宽裤腿形成膝部向前突出的立体轮廓；“H.D.”是日语“膝盖突出”的缩写。另一家日本零售商 JEANS FACTORY 的详细指南列出牛仔和军装等不同面料版本，说明 H.D. 是一套可反复变化的轮廓，而不是单一面料。BEAMS 介绍，这次的上衣专为 BEAMS BOY 重新设计，因此值得看的不仅是侧条颜色，还有裤腿和袖部怎样分别处理体积。[ARZACH 裤型指南](https://arzachstore.jp/editorial/neeldeshdpants) · [JEANS FACTORY 指南](https://www.jeansfactory.jp/content/feature.php?d=1741334400) · [BEAMS 公告](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5066/)

双方以前也把同一套语言改造成不同衣服。BEAMS BOY 原宿店 2024 年介绍过以工装丹宁配色制作的 H.D. 运动裤；同年另一套运动系列借用了纽约冰球队配色。2026 年初的 BEAMS JAPAN 别注则把做旧效果放进拉链连帽衫与宽裤。这些是不同时间的旧合作，不能当作本次系列的商品清单。[2024 年工装配色](https://www.beams.co.jp/blog/hry/147135/) · [2024 年运动系列](https://www.beams.co.jp/blog/beamsboy/156442/) · [2026 年初别注](https://www.beams.co.jp/blog/jk/175197/)

这种运动服与传统服饰的混搭，也符合 BEAMS BOY 长期的选题。品牌 2023 年的风格索引把户外、传统、工装、军事和运动列为五个方向；一位曾参与首店工作的买手在品牌的另一篇回顾中谈到，自己留意旧衣里能承受反复穿着的细节。两份资料介绍的是品牌自己的立场，不等于证明这一套新品具备某种实测耐久性。[BEAMS BOY 风格索引](https://www.beams.co.jp/blog/hry/126967/) · [前买手的旧衣回顾](https://digroo.beams.co.jp/blogs/magazine/column-002)

NEEDLES 的设计师清水庆三在 SSENSE 的采访里回忆，创立品牌时希望把从海外看见的东西变成日本制造、带一点变化的衣服；他在 Couverture & The Garbstore 的另一次采访里则谈到自己长期对 1970 年代与电影的兴趣。谈及蝴蝶标识，清水在 Esquire 的采访中把它追溯到电影《巴比龙》中的纹身；GQ 的另一篇设计师采访也记录了这个视觉来源。2022 年他还回忆自己早年穿过一套宽裤腿的 Yohji Yamamoto 西装。 这些访谈帮助理解他一贯的参考方式，并不证明影片或旧西装直接启发了本次大学配色。[SSENSE 双人访谈](https://www.ssense.com/en-ca/editorial/fashion/born-to-run-keizo-shimizu-daiki-suzukis-americana-dream) · [设计师旧访谈](https://www.couvertureandthegarbstore.com/blogs/journal/from-the-archive-keizo-shimizu) · [Esquire](https://www.esquire.com/style/mens-fashion/a33668219/needles-dr-martens-keizo-shimizu-interview/) · [WILDSIDE 对谈](https://wildside-online.com/shop/pages/content_detail_220720_02.aspx) · [GQ](https://www.gq.com/story/the-story-behind-needles)

学院色彩、运动侧条和柔软的宽松轮廓在这里各自保留了身份。对穿着者来说，选择并不只在于哪一种配色：短一点的上衣、宽裤腿以及露出多少鞋面，都会改变整套衣服的比例。TIDEZINE 对官方造型图的分析提出了类似的观察；具体是否合身，还是要等实际试穿。[TIDEZINE](https://tidezine.com/en/news/needles-beams-boy-ivy-hijideru-hd-track-2026)
stories.enMarkdown:
NEEDLES and BEAMS BOY have made a track set designed to be separated and recombined: three colours for the top and three different colours for the trousers. BEAMS says the two special-order pieces launch on November 12 at selected Japanese stores and online. The newly developed Hijideru crewneck costs ¥23,100 including tax; the H.D.-shaped trousers cost ¥31,900. The top uses smooth polyester jersey, while the trousers are made in lustrous velour. [BEAMS announcement](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5066/)

The colours take American college colours as their starting point without simply reproducing a school crest. BEAMS BOY has chosen combinations for the body, side stripes and butterfly embroidery: the tops come in light grey, charcoal and olive, the trousers in black, brown and navy. They can be worn together or mixed. JustFresh observed all six colours open for online pre-order on November 1; that is not a guarantee of stock today. Check current listings and garment measurements. [Official colours and prices](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5066/) · [TIDEZINE styling analysis](https://tidezine.com/en/news/needles-beams-boy-ivy-hijideru-hd-track-2026) · [JustFresh pre-order observation](https://www.justfresh.co/fashion/needles-beams-boy-track-series-november-12)

The crewneck takes its shape from the H.D. trousers. Japanese retailer ARZACH’s guide to several H.D. versions explains how darts at the waist and hem create a wide form that appears to push forward at the knees; “H.D.” abbreviates the Japanese phrase for a protruding knee. Another Japanese retailer, JEANS FACTORY, illustrates the cut in denim and military-inspired variants, showing that H.D. is a recurring silhouette rather than a single fabric. BEAMS says the top was designed afresh for BEAMS BOY, so the proportions of sleeve and trouser leg matter as much as the colours of the stripes. [ARZACH guide](https://arzachstore.jp/editorial/neeldeshdpants) · [JEANS FACTORY guide](https://www.jeansfactory.jp/content/feature.php?d=1741334400) · [BEAMS announcement](https://www.beams.co.jp/news/5066/)

The partners have reshaped the same visual vocabulary before. A 2024 BEAMS BOY Harajuku feature described H.D. track pants using colours inspired by denim workwear; another 2024 sports collection drew on the colours of a New York ice-hockey team. An early-2026 BEAMS JAPAN edition put distressed finishing on a zip hoodie and wide trousers. These are earlier, separate collaborations, not an inventory of the current release. [2024 workwear colours](https://www.beams.co.jp/blog/hry/147135/) · [2024 sports series](https://www.beams.co.jp/blog/beamsboy/156442/) · [Early-2026 edition](https://www.beams.co.jp/blog/jk/175197/)

Combining sport and traditional clothing belongs to a longer BEAMS BOY approach. Its 2023 style index identified outdoor, traditional, work, military and sports clothing as five recurring areas. In another retrospective, a former buyer who had worked at the first store discussed noticing vintage garment details built to withstand wear. Both accounts describe the brand’s own outlook; neither constitutes a durability test of the new pieces. [BEAMS BOY index](https://www.beams.co.jp/blog/hry/126967/) · [Former buyer’s account](https://digroo.beams.co.jp/blogs/magazine/column-002)

In an SSENSE interview, NEEDLES designer Keizo Shimizu recalled wanting to make clothes in Japan that adapted things he had seen abroad with a small change. In another conversation with Couverture & The Garbstore, he discussed his continuing interest in 1970s style and film. Speaking to Esquire, Shimizu traced the butterfly emblem to a tattoo in *Papillon*; a separate GQ interview recorded the same visual reference. In 2022 he also recalled wearing a Yohji Yamamoto suit with wide trousers earlier in his career. The interviews explain his broader practice; they do not establish that the film or that suit directly inspired this collection’s college colours. [SSENSE interview](https://www.ssense.com/en-ca/editorial/fashion/born-to-run-keizo-shimizu-daiki-suzukis-americana-dream) · [Founder interview](https://www.couvertureandthegarbstore.com/blogs/journal/from-the-archive-keizo-shimizu) · [Esquire](https://www.esquire.com/style/mens-fashion/a33668219/needles-dr-martens-keizo-shimizu-interview/) · [WILDSIDE conversation](https://wildside-online.com/shop/pages/content_detail_220720_02.aspx) · [GQ](https://www.gq.com/story/the-story-behind-needles)

The collegiate colours, sports stripes and soft, voluminous shapes each remain visible. For a wearer, the choice is not limited to a colour combination: the length of the top, the width of the trousers and how much of a shoe is visible can change the proportions. TIDEZINE makes a similar observation from the official styling photographs; actual fit remains a question for trying the clothes. [TIDEZINE](https://tidezine.com/en/news/needles-beams-boy-ivy-hijideru-hd-track-2026)

stories.title: Veronica Ditting 的微型书展：把一整个世界放进掌心
stories.titleEn: Veronica Ditting’s Small Print: A World in the Palm
stories.zhDeck: 一间画廊里，最小的书只有 2.4 × 2.9 毫米，读它需要放大镜。洛杉矶 Marta 画廊正在展出创意总监 Veronica Ditting 的微型书收藏《Small Print》，展期从 11 月 7 日至 12 月 19 日。馆方列出的藏书共 258 本。我们没有现场到访，以下展品和导览信息来自馆方与媒体介绍。[Marta 展览介绍](https://marta.la/exhibitions/veronica-ditting-small-print) · [Wallpaper 报道](https://www.wallpaper.com/design-interiors/veronica-ditting-small-print-exhibition-los-angeles)
stories.enDeck: A Los Angeles exhibition gathers a collection of miniature books.
stories.zhMarkdown:
一间画廊里，最小的书只有 2.4 × 2.9 毫米，读它需要放大镜。洛杉矶 Marta 画廊正在展出创意总监 Veronica Ditting 的微型书收藏《Small Print》，展期从 11 月 7 日至 12 月 19 日。馆方列出的藏书共 258 本。我们没有现场到访，以下展品和导览信息来自馆方与媒体介绍。[Marta 展览介绍](https://marta.la/exhibitions/veronica-ditting-small-print) · [Wallpaper 报道](https://www.wallpaper.com/design-interiors/veronica-ditting-small-print-exhibition-los-angeles)

这些小书并不只供人惊叹尺寸。Ditting 在德国长大，父母旅行时带的袖珍词典成为她收藏的起点。她曾向与自己合作七年的设计师 Iranzu Baker 讲起，能够把一本书完整放进掌心，会改变人与物的关系；她也会在旅行时偶然走进旧书店寻找新藏品。Baker 的采访针对 2025 年伦敦 Tenderbooks 的首展，并非此次洛杉矶现场。[Baker 采访](https://www.iranzubaker.com/miniature-treasures-with-veronica-ditting-interview)

最小的一册是德国艺术家 Josua Reichert 的《Das Kleinste Buch der Welt》。展品还包括 1890 年代 David Bryce 的拇指词典、三得利 1967 至 1970 年出版的一套小书；《Wallpaper*》报道这套书共有 36 册，以及装在蒂芙尼银盒中的 Webster 词典。展览设置电话语音导览：观众拨号并按书旁编号，听讲述者介绍藏品。不同用途的书放在一起，显示便携、设计与收藏如何交叠。[Marta](https://marta.la/exhibitions/veronica-ditting-small-print) · [Wallpaper](https://www.wallpaper.com/design-interiors/veronica-ditting-small-print-exhibition-los-angeles)

书的大小也是工作方法。《World of Interiors》2025 年到 Ditting 的工作室采访她，注意到她为 Hermès Beauty 设计的邀请函长度正好是唇膏包装的三倍；她为《The Gentlewoman》处理标题与边注时，也反复考虑比例。她曾告诉 SSENSE，自己不喜欢把书强行做成摆在茶几上的大开本。早在 2019 年，她向 It’s Nice That 解释，标题对她而言不只有形状，还关乎读出来的声音。这些旧采访不能证明她设计当前每件展品，却帮助理解她为什么关注物件如何被阅读。[World of Interiors](https://www.worldofinteriors.com/story/small-print-display-tenderbooks-london) · [SSENSE](https://www.ssense.com/en-de/editorial/culture/the-art-of-formal-friction-with-creative-director-veronica-ditting) · [It’s Nice That](https://www.itsnicethat.com/features/veronica-ditting-in-conversation-graphic-design-030619)

这种对手感的关注，展览也遇到了一个矛盾：观众通常不能随意翻动珍贵藏书。Ditting 2024 年在京都的个人回顾展《Folio Folio Folio》把印刷作品放到特别制作的展架上；她当时告诉 Mastermind，团队花时间讨论如何把这些原本适合触摸的作品展示出来。京都旧展与洛杉矶的电话导览方式不同，但两者都需要把纸上体验转译给观看者。[Mastermind 采访](https://mastermindparis.com/features/living-in-a-material-world-with-veronica-ditting/)

微型书有长久的实用史。爱尔兰利默里克大学 Bolton Library 的修复师介绍，小书曾方便携带，收藏与制作技巧后来也成为它们的吸引力；丹麦皇家图书馆则指出，从 17 世纪起印刷微型书的例子逐渐增多。这是关于馆藏与书籍史的背景，不是说馆藏物件出现在 Marta。[Bolton Library](https://specialcollections.ul.ie/miniatures-in-the-bolton-library/) · [丹麦皇家图书馆](https://www.kb.dk/en/inspiration/book-festival-royal-danish-library/smallest-book)

展览也包括 Dieter Roth 的艺术家书与 Hanuman Books。MoMA 的 Roth 研究讨论他如何用镂空、纸张和翻页打破对书的期待；那是对艺术家实践的背景研究，不能据此断言 MoMA 分析的具体书册也在这次展出。关于 Hanuman，研究者 Peter Maber 追溯了 Francesco Clemente、Raymond Foye 与印度 Kalakshetra Press 的合作，并特别提到印刷者 C. T. Nachiappan 对排版与设计的贡献。印度艺术基金会的 Stuti Bhavsar 项目则提出另一个问题：这些利用印度工艺制作的书，如何在南印度被重新带入流通。这个问题提醒我们，书籍的故事也包括制作与传播的人。[MoMA 研究](https://www.moma.org/d/pdfs/W1siZiIsIjIwMTgvMDYvMTMvM2ZpOTlybjNfUm90aEVkaXRpb25zX1BSRVZJRVcucGRmIl1d/RothEditions_PREVIEW.pdf?sha=fadec412eb7f3d42) · [Maber 研究](https://nul.repository.guildhe.ac.uk/id/eprint/1599/1/MABER%20Clemente%20Book%20Chapter.pdf) · [印度艺术基金会](https://indiaifa.org/grants-projects/stuti-bhavsar.html)

从口袋词典到艺术家书，《Small Print》把注意力拉回到一件很小的事情：一本书的尺寸、纸张与装订，如何决定我们接近它的方式。它的趣味在于细看，也在于小小一册可以连着怎样复杂的制作史。
stories.enMarkdown:
The smallest book in a Los Angeles gallery measures just 2.4 × 2.9 millimetres and requires a magnifying glass to read. Creative director Veronica Ditting’s miniature-book collection is on view in *Small Print* at Marta from November 7 through December 19. The gallery lists 258 books in the collection. We have not visited, so the objects and tour described here are based on the gallery and published reporting. [Marta](https://marta.la/exhibitions/veronica-ditting-small-print) · [Wallpaper](https://www.wallpaper.com/design-interiors/veronica-ditting-small-print-exhibition-los-angeles)

The appeal is not simply a contest in smallness. Growing up in Germany, Ditting became fascinated by the pocket dictionaries her parents took on holiday. In an interview about the first, 2025 Tenderbooks presentation, she told designer Iranzu Baker, a colleague for seven years, that holding a whole book in one palm changes one’s relationship with it. Ditting also described finding additions by chance in second-hand bookshops while travelling. That interview concerns the earlier London show, not a visit to Marta. [Baker interview](https://www.iranzubaker.com/miniature-treasures-with-veronica-ditting-interview)

The smallest object is German artist Josua Reichert’s *Das Kleinste Buch der Welt*. Other items include an 1890s David Bryce thumb dictionary, a miniature-book series published for Suntory between 1967 and 1970, which *Wallpaper* describes as comprising 36 volumes, and a Webster dictionary in a Tiffany silver case. For the audio tour, visitors dial a number and use the signs beside selected books to choose what to hear. Together the objects bring portability, design and collecting into view. [Marta](https://marta.la/exhibitions/veronica-ditting-small-print) · [Wallpaper](https://www.wallpaper.com/design-interiors/veronica-ditting-small-print-exhibition-los-angeles)

Scale is also part of Ditting’s working practice. Visiting her studio in 2025, *The World of Interiors* noted that an Hermès Beauty invitation she designed was three times the length of its lipstick package; the magazine also observed her attention to the proportions of headlines and marginal notes in *The Gentlewoman*. In an earlier interview with SSENSE, she said she disliked forcing books into oversized coffee-table formats. In 2019 she told It’s Nice That that a headline matters to her for its sound as well as its appearance. These interviews do not establish that she designed every object in the present show; they help explain her interest in how objects are read. [The World of Interiors](https://www.worldofinteriors.com/story/small-print-display-tenderbooks-london) · [SSENSE](https://www.ssense.com/en-de/editorial/culture/the-art-of-formal-friction-with-creative-director-veronica-ditting) · [It’s Nice That](https://www.itsnicethat.com/features/veronica-ditting-in-conversation-graphic-design-030619)

That attention to touch creates a challenge in an exhibition where precious books cannot generally be handled freely. Ditting’s 2024 Kyoto retrospective *Folio Folio Folio* placed printed works on specially made stands. She told Mastermind that the team spent time considering how to exhibit objects made to be touched. The Kyoto installation and Marta’s phone tour use different methods, but both translate a paper experience for a viewer. [Mastermind interview](https://mastermindparis.com/features/living-in-a-material-world-with-veronica-ditting/)

Miniature books also have a long practical history. A conservator at the University of Limerick’s Bolton Library describes small books made for travel as well as collecting and craft. The Royal Danish Library notes the increasing publication of printed miniatures from the 17th century onward. These sources provide historical context; their library objects should not be confused with the Marta exhibits. [Bolton Library](https://specialcollections.ul.ie/miniatures-in-the-bolton-library/) · [Royal Danish Library](https://www.kb.dk/en/inspiration/book-festival-royal-danish-library/smallest-book)

The exhibition includes artist’s books by Dieter Roth and examples of Hanuman Books. MoMA’s research on Roth discusses how cuts, paper and page turns challenged expectations of a book; the particular works analysed there should not automatically be assumed to be on view at Marta. Researcher Peter Maber traces Hanuman’s collaboration between Francesco Clemente, Raymond Foye and India’s Kalakshetra Press, noting printer C. T. Nachiappan’s contribution to typography and design. A project by Stuti Bhavsar supported by the India Foundation for the Arts asks how books made using Indian craft might be brought back into circulation in South Asia. The history includes the people who made and distributed them. [MoMA research](https://www.moma.org/d/pdfs/W1siZiIsIjIwMTgvMDYvMTMvM2ZpOTlybjNfUm90aEVkaXRpb25zX1BSRVZJRVcucGRmIl1d/RothEditions_PREVIEW.pdf?sha=fadec412eb7f3d42) · [Maber research](https://nul.repository.guildhe.ac.uk/id/eprint/1599/1/MABER%20Clemente%20Book%20Chapter.pdf) · [India Foundation for the Arts](https://indiaifa.org/grants-projects/stuti-bhavsar.html)

From a pocket dictionary to an artist’s book, *Small Print* brings attention back to how a book’s scale, paper and binding shape the way we approach it. Its pleasure lies in looking closely, and in the surprisingly complex histories a tiny object can carry.

LOEWE 把《圣诞夜惊魂》的角色请进了一只包。品牌与 Disney 推出的节日系列将于 11 月 12 日发售，包袋、配件、成衣与香氛共同借用这部 1993 年定格动画的视觉世界。品牌说，它接触了影片的原始手稿和木偶档案，再用皮革拼嵌、刺绣与印花重新处理角色和场景。[LOEWE 系列介绍](https://www.loewe.com/eur/es/pd/stories-collection/ss27-tim-burton.html)

有些细节需要打开包才会看见。Tim Burton 在《Vanity Fair》的采访中介绍，Jack Skellington 躲在一只手袋内部，幽灵犬 Zero 浮现在另一只包的侧面；他喜欢设计师对材质和纹理的重新解释。影片从他 1982 年写的一首诗开始，但银幕上的作品由 Henry Selick 执导。把两人的角色分开，才能看清这次联名带回来的不止是一个作者的签名。[Burton 访谈](https://www.vanityfair.com/story/loewe-tim-burton-nightmare-before-christmas-collaboration) · [BFI 对 Selick 的历史采访](https://bfidatadigipres.github.io/christmas%20films/2023/12/10/nightmare-before-christmas/)

电影中的细长身体，实际上首先是一道制作难题。曾参与项目的 David Bossert 回顾，角色制作团队必须为 Jack 极细的脚踝设计可以支撑动作的金属关节，再把木偶固定在布景上逐帧拍摄。主角还需要多具替身，以便不同动画师在不同布景同时工作。看起来轻巧的动作，背后是雕塑、机械与镜头之间一连串小调整。[David Bossert：偶人制作](https://www.davidbossert.com/assets/article-nightmare_before_xmas-puppets.pdf)

导演和摄影师也在决定这个世界的光。摄影指导 Pete Kozachik 在当年的制作记录中写道，团队参考了黑白惊悚片的光影，把阴影、硬光与布景的角度用在彩色影片里；圣诞镇则采用更柔和的光和暖色灯饰。Selick 在另一篇采访里说，万圣镇的纹理参考了 Edward Gorey 等插画家的作品，而圣诞镇更柔软、圆润。两个节日世界之间的区别，由材料、造型和灯光共同完成。[American Cinematographer 制作记录](https://theasc.com/article/nightmare-before-christmas/) · [BFI 采访](https://bfidatadigipres.github.io/christmas%20films/2023/12/10/nightmare-before-christmas/)

这种手工感也包含节奏。Selick 回忆，Danny Elfman 的歌曲在完整剧本确定之前就已成为制作的结构，动画师围绕旋律和时长组织场景；在另一场幕后对谈中，动画师 Anthony Scott 说，歌曲《Poor Jack》的动画花了他六个月。对观众而言，歌声是流动的；对制作者而言，它由一帧帧可以调整的动作构成。[Cartoon Brew 采访](https://www.cartoonbrew.com/feature-film/henry-selick-looks-back-on-25-years-of-nightmare-before-christmas-163558.html) · [D23 对谈记录](https://d23.com/d23-event-recaps/d23-goes-behind-the-screams-of-the-nightmare-before-christmas-at-comic-con/)

在另一篇 2015 年采访中，Selick 还回忆，制作刚开始时团队已经有上映日期，但当时 Danny Elfman 只写好了两首歌；动画团队与后来加入的编剧 Caroline Thompson 边制作边推进故事。这是导演对当年流程的回忆，不代表现在的合作系列使用了同一套流程。[Selick 独立访谈](https://spinningplatters.com/spinning-platter-interview-henry-selick-director-of-nightmare-before-christmas/)

研究者 Alice Gambrell 从劳动的角度看这部片：银幕上的动作看似自然，其实由动画师在画面之间反复移动实体物件而形成。她把电影里制作圣诞礼物的场面与定格动画自身的制作过程联系起来，提醒观众留意那些不在镜头里的工作。[Gambrell 的定格动画研究](https://eclass.aegean.gr/modules/document/file.php/511154/Animation%20Journals/AP3/s9_Gambrell.pdf)

把图画转译成物件，也不是 LOEWE 第一次尝试。2021 年与《龙猫》的合作中，Dazed 在品牌合作文章里记录，工匠先描摹图案，再将不同形状切入皮革，运用拼嵌技法制作角色。LVMH 的 2025 年年报回顾 Puzzle 十周年时，也列出贴布、刺绣、压纹和皮革拼嵌等不同做法。那是旧系列的制作背景，不代表每件新联名单品都采用了同样步骤。[Dazed：旧系列制作](https://www.dazeddigital.com/fashion/article/51590/1/closer-look-loewe-studio-ghibli-my-neighbour-totoro-collection-jonathan-anderson) · [LVMH 2025 年报](https://hosting.fluidbook.com/LVMH/2025interactiveannualreport/en/data/texts.pdf)

日本《Precious》曾拆解一只旧款 Puzzle 的制作：皮革需要裁片、处理边缘、拼接和缝合，手柄也由工匠安装。它的图文记录关注的是已有包型，不是《圣诞夜惊魂》系列的逐件生产说明，却能让人理解为什么同一张角色图案到了皮革上，会面对与画纸完全不同的结构问题。[Precious 制作记录](https://precious.jp/articles/-/25615)

Burton 的草图、服装和布景过去也在伦敦 Design Museum 的回顾展中并置；这次商品合作则让档案里的形象进入一种日常物件。Selick 在 2024 年谈定格动画时说，他希望观众仍能感觉到作品曾被人触碰。电影中的木偶与手袋当然承担不同功能，但两者都让人看到：一幅画如何经过很多人的手，变成可以在空间里存在的东西。[Design Museum 旧展](https://beta.designmuseum.org/exhibitions/the-world-of-tim-burton) · [BFI 对 Selick 的 2024 年采访](https://www.bfi.org.uk/sight-and-sound/interviews/stop-motion-henry-selick-coraline)
stories.enMarkdown:
LOEWE has put a character from *The Nightmare Before Christmas* inside a bag. The house’s holiday collection with Disney is due on November 12, bringing the 1993 stop-motion film to bags, accessories, ready-to-wear and fragrance. LOEWE says it worked with the film’s original drawings and puppet archive, translating characters and scenes through leather marquetry, embroidery and print. [LOEWE collection](https://www.loewe.com/eur/es/pd/stories-collection/ss27-tim-burton.html)

Some details are only visible when a bag is opened. In an interview with *Vanity Fair*, Tim Burton described Jack Skellington peeking from a handbag’s interior and the ghost dog Zero appearing on another bag. He welcomed the designers’ interpretation of the film’s textures and elements. The story began with a poem he wrote in 1982, but Henry Selick directed the film. Naming their different roles makes room for the people who turned the initial drawings into the finished work. [Burton interview](https://www.vanityfair.com/story/loewe-tim-burton-nightmare-before-christmas-collaboration) · [BFI’s historical Selick interview](https://bfidatadigipres.github.io/christmas%20films/2023/12/10/nightmare-before-christmas/)

The film’s slender bodies began as a practical problem. David Bossert, who worked on the project, recounts how puppet makers had to engineer metal joints small enough for Jack’s ankles but strong enough for animation, then fasten the puppet to the set between frames. Several versions of the principal characters let animators work on different sets at once. What looks like effortless movement depended on a chain of adjustments across sculpture, mechanics and camera work. [David Bossert on puppet fabrication](https://www.davidbossert.com/assets/article-nightmare_before_xmas-puppets.pdf)

The director and cinematographer also shaped the light. In his production account, cinematographer Pete Kozachik describes borrowing hard light, shadows and strong angles from black-and-white thrillers for the color film; Christmas Town received softer light and warmer practical lamps. Selick told another interviewer that Halloween Town’s textures drew on illustrators including Edward Gorey, while Christmas Town was softer and rounder. Materials, shape and light together distinguish the two holiday worlds. [American Cinematographer production account](https://theasc.com/article/nightmare-before-christmas/) · [BFI interview](https://bfidatadigipres.github.io/christmas%20films/2023/12/10/nightmare-before-christmas/)

Handwork also has a rhythm. Selick recalled that Danny Elfman’s songs became structural anchors before the script was complete, giving animators a duration and beat around which to build scenes. At a later panel, animator Anthony Scott said the “Poor Jack” sequence took him six months to animate. A song flows for the viewer; for its makers, it is assembled from frames, poses and revisions. [Cartoon Brew interview](https://www.cartoonbrew.com/feature-film/henry-selick-looks-back-on-25-years-of-nightmare-before-christmas-163558.html) · [D23 panel report](https://d23.com/d23-event-recaps/d23-goes-behind-the-screams-of-the-nightmare-before-christmas-at-comic-con/)

In a separate 2015 interview, Selick recalled that production began with a release date already set, even though Danny Elfman had written only two songs. Animators began work while screenwriter Caroline Thompson joined and the story continued to evolve. His recollection concerns the film, not the making of the current collection. [Independent Selick interview](https://spinningplatters.com/spinning-platter-interview-henry-selick-director-of-nightmare-before-christmas/)

Scholar Alice Gambrell reads the film through its labour: movement that seems natural on screen depends on animators repeatedly moving physical objects between frames. She connects scenes of Christmas gift-making with the work of stop-motion production itself, drawing attention to the labour outside the frame. [Gambrell on stop-motion work](https://eclass.aegean.gr/modules/document/file.php/511154/Animation%20Journals/AP3/s9_Gambrell.pdf)

Translating drawings into objects is not new to LOEWE. In a 2021 partnership article about its *My Neighbor Totoro* collection, Dazed documented how motifs were traced and shapes cut into leather to build the characters. LVMH’s 2025 annual report lists appliqué, embroidery, embossing and leather marquetry among the techniques used across ten years of the Puzzle bag. Those accounts concern earlier collections; they do not establish the exact production steps for every piece in the new range. [Dazed on the earlier collection](https://www.dazeddigital.com/fashion/article/51590/1/closer-look-loewe-studio-ghibli-my-neighbour-totoro-collection-jonathan-anderson) · [LVMH 2025 annual report](https://hosting.fluidbook.com/LVMH/2025interactiveannualreport/en/data/texts.pdf)

Japanese publication *Precious* once documented the making of an earlier Puzzle bag: leather pieces were cut, their edges finished, then joined and stitched, with handles attached by hand. It was describing an existing design rather than this film collection, but it shows why moving an image from paper to leather raises questions of structure as well as appearance. [Precious making-of](https://precious.jp/articles/-/25615)

Burton’s drawings, costumes and sets were previously brought together in a Design Museum retrospective in London. This new collaboration moves images from an archive onto objects used in daily life. Speaking about stop motion in 2024, Selick said he wanted viewers still to feel that a real person had touched the work. Puppets and handbags have different purposes, yet both make visible how a drawing can pass through many hands before it occupies space. [Design Museum retrospective](https://beta.designmuseum.org/exhibitions/the-world-of-tim-burton) · [BFI’s 2024 Selick interview](https://www.bfi.org.uk/sight-and-sound/interviews/stop-motion-henry-selick-coraline)

stories.zhMarkdown:
以 Brain Dead 的洛杉矶影院为中心，一周之内可以看动画、组装树脂机器人，也可以玩一场发生在未来城市的角色扮演游戏。品牌的 Fantasy Fest: CyberCon 在 11 月 10 日至 15 日举行。11 日的《Neurocrash》被设定在 2087 年的“Los Angelyne”；12 日有 Mesh 网络设备工作坊，13 日安排韮澤靖主题展览与新书活动，15 日则有树脂模型课。所有时间均为洛杉矶当地时间；我们没有到现场，活动安排以主办方页面为准。[Brain Dead 活动日程](https://wearebraindead.com/pages/cybercon)

电影是其中一条线。11 月 10 日节目包括 1987 年的动画短片集《Robot Carnival》；11 月 12 日，Iggor Cavalera 将为 1985 年动画《天使之卵》现场配乐。前一部的多种机器人故事被影评网站 Aside House 视作短片集的长处，同时也认为各段质量不一。后一部由押井守执导、天野喜孝参与原案与美术；两人在 2025 年接受 MANTANWEB 采访时回顾，它以少量对白和较长镜头构造世界。这些是影片及历史采访的信息，不代表我们已经看过本次现场配乐。[Aside House 影评](https://asidehouse.com/screen/robot-carnival-the-anime-anthology-of-machine-dreams/) · [押井守与天野喜孝采访](https://en.mantan-web.jp/e_article/20251013dog00m200001000c.html)

11 月 13 日的节目从另一处入口进入同样的想象力：展览与 Peow Studio 的《Creature Core》英文版新书活动纪念已故艺术家韮澤靖，计划讨论车库套件与日本动画的影响，随后放映 2004 年的《哥斯拉 FINAL WARS》。11 月 15 日，garagekit.club 的课程则让参与者处理树脂零件、清理表面并为关节加固。主办方说课程包含模型和基础工具；活动及票务可能变化，出发前应再查页面。[Brain Dead 活动详情](https://wearebraindead.com/pages/cybercon)

车库套件的历史说明了为什么这些角色会同时出现在纸面、银幕与手上。海洋堂顾问宫胁修一向模型师大越友惠回忆，1980 年代初他们因不满足于市面上的怪兽模型，与经常聚在店里的顾客一起制作自己的作品。Zoukei-Mura 创办人也说，顾客手捏的哥斯拉等怪兽启发他开始生产套件。研究者 Bob Rehak 解释，日本模型爱好者会先用黏土塑形，再用硅胶翻模，并以树脂等材料复制；CyberCon 对谈合作方 Zimmerit 也曾回顾，1992 年《Creature Core》收录了韮澤靖的漫画、模型与角色扮演游戏相关创作。这些是历史记述，不是对 CyberCon 课程的现场观察。[Zimmerit 研究](https://www.zimmerit.moe/yasushi-nirasawa-cinematic-influences/) · [大越友惠对宫胁的采访](https://stg.discover.osaka-info.jp/en/articles/osaka-figure-culture) · [Zoukei-Mura 回忆](https://www.zoukeimura.co.jp/en/sentiment/oyajiblog_112.html) · [Rehak 模型文化研究](https://www.academia.edu/3750995/Materializing_Monsters_Aurora_Models_Garage_Kits_and_the_Object_Practices_of_Horror_Fandom)

除了动手制作，观众也可以一起看别人比赛。11 月 14 日上午 9 点安排免费《英雄联盟》世界赛观赛活动；这是观赛活动时间，并不自动代表比赛开赛时间。节目表还列有《万智牌》比赛、动画放映与音乐活动，部分项目页面已标注候补。比赛分别安排在洛杉矶和波特兰的不同场地，参加前需要核对具体地点。[活动日程与票务](https://wearebraindead.com/pages/cybercon)

Brain Dead 为什么经营电影院？联合创办人 Kyle Ng 在 2020 年告诉 Complex，疫情时期他担心影院、木偶剧场和音乐场地失去生存空间，因此希望接手熟悉的 Fairfax 旧影院。Vogue 后来报道，这里结合了放映、演出、餐饮与品牌商品；LAist 在 2024 年到访时记录了放映室、院子，以及向会员征集片单的做法。这些报道描述的是空间的既有经营方式，不能替代对本周活动的现场评估。[Complex 采访](https://www.complex.com/style/a/lei-takanashi/brain-dead-studios-kyle-ng-movie-theater-interview) · [Vogue 报道](https://www.vogue.com/article/subcultures-and-cinema-why-brain-dead-isnt-just-about-the-clothes) · [LAist 现场报道](https://laist.com/news/how-to-la/how-a-streetwear-brand-has-given-new-life-and-sound-to-a-former-silent-movie-theater)

Ng 在 2024 年的 Near Future Laboratory 播客中回忆，自己早期就被电影、雕塑、设计与表演交叉的工作吸引；当时他也把电影院描述为品牌讲述文化故事的更大空间。美联社此前走访洛杉矶其他独立影院时发现，观众同样珍视选片以外的聚会和交流；报道也提到疫情后恢复并不容易。把这两份背景放在一起，可以看见 CyberCon 的尝试：让人因为不同的兴趣来到同一个地方，再决定要不要继续认识彼此。[Near Future Laboratory 采访](https://nearfuturelaboratory.com/blog/2024/07/episode-090-kyle-ng/) · [美联社独立影院报道](https://apnews.com/article/hollywood-movie-theaters-quentin-tarantino-cinerama-dome-0347c0912164525998f0c24e6c059878)
stories.enMarkdown:
At Brain Dead’s Los Angeles cinema, one week can include animated films, a resin robot build and a role-playing game set in a future city. The brand’s Fantasy Fest: CyberCon runs November 10–15. *Neurocrash* on November 11 imagines “Los Angelyne” in 2087; a mesh-network device workshop follows on November 12, a Yasushi Nirasawa exhibition and book event on November 13, and a resin-model class on November 15. All times are local to Los Angeles. We have not attended, and the schedule comes from the organiser. [Brain Dead programme](https://wearebraindead.com/pages/cybercon)

Film is one thread through the programme. The November 10 schedule included the 1987 animation anthology *Robot Carnival*; on November 12, Iggor Cavalera is scheduled to perform a live score to the 1985 film *Angel’s Egg*. Film site Aside House sees the range of robot stories in the anthology as a strength while finding the individual segments uneven. *Angel’s Egg* was directed by Mamoru Oshii with concept and art direction by Yoshitaka Amano; discussing its 40th anniversary with MANTANWEB in 2025, the filmmakers revisited its sparse dialogue and long takes. These are historical accounts of the films, not a review of this week’s performance. [Aside House review](https://asidehouse.com/screen/robot-carnival-the-anime-anthology-of-machine-dreams/) · [Oshii and Amano interview](https://en.mantan-web.jp/e_article/20251013dog00m200001000c.html)

The November 13 programme approaches the imagination from another direction. An exhibition and Peow Studio launch of the English edition of *Creature Core* honour the late artist Yasushi Nirasawa; a panel on garage kits and Japanese animation is followed by a screening of 2004’s *Godzilla: Final Wars*. On November 15, garagekit.club’s class is scheduled to teach participants to prepare resin parts, clean surfaces and pin joints. The organiser says a model kit and starter tools are included. Plans and ticket availability may change. [Brain Dead event details](https://wearebraindead.com/pages/cybercon)

The history of garage kits helps explain why these forms can move between paper, screen and hands. Kaiyodo advisor Shuichi Miyawaki told model-maker Tomoe Ogoshi that, dissatisfied with available monster figures in the early 1980s, he and the shop’s regulars started making their own. Zoukei-Mura’s founder also recalls being inspired by customers who brought in hand-sculpted Godzilla figures. Researcher Bob Rehak describes how Japanese makers sculpted figures in clay, made silicone moulds and reproduced them in materials including resin. CyberCon panel partner Zimmerit also traced how Nirasawa’s 1992 *Creature Core* brought together comics, models and role-playing material. These are historical accounts, not eyewitness reports of the CyberCon workshop. [Zimmerit](https://www.zimmerit.moe/yasushi-nirasawa-cinematic-influences/) · [Ogoshi’s interview with Miyawaki](https://stg.discover.osaka-info.jp/en/articles/osaka-figure-culture) · [Zoukei-Mura recollection](https://www.zoukeimura.co.jp/en/sentiment/oyajiblog_112.html) · [Rehak on model culture](https://www.academia.edu/3750995/Materializing_Monsters_Aurora_Models_Garage_Kits_and_the_Object_Practices_of_Horror_Fandom)

There is also room to watch others play. A free *League of Legends* world-championship watch party is scheduled for 9 a.m. on November 14; that is the gathering’s start time and should not be assumed to be the match’s start. The programme also lists *Magic: The Gathering* tournaments, screenings and music events, with some marked waitlist. The tournaments are at separate venues in Los Angeles and Portland, so participants should check the location. [Programme and tickets](https://wearebraindead.com/pages/cybercon)

Why would a clothing brand run a cinema? In 2020, co-founder Kyle Ng told Complex he worried that pandemic closures would leave theatres, puppet venues and music spaces unable to survive, and wanted to take over the familiar former Fairfax cinema. Vogue later described a venue combining screenings, performances, food and merchandise. Visiting in 2024, LAist reported on the screening room and patio, and on members being invited to suggest films. These accounts describe the venue’s existing practice; they do not substitute for a first-hand assessment of this week’s event. [Complex interview](https://www.complex.com/style/a/lei-takanashi/brain-dead-studios-kyle-ng-movie-theater-interview) · [Vogue report](https://www.vogue.com/article/subcultures-and-cinema-why-brain-dead-isnt-just-about-the-clothes) · [LAist visit](https://laist.com/news/how-to-la/how-a-streetwear-brand-has-given-new-life-and-sound-to-a-former-silent-movie-theater)

On the Near Future Laboratory podcast in 2024, Ng recalled an early attraction to work combining film, sculpture, design and performance; he described the cinema as a larger space in which the brand could tell cultural stories. Reporting on other independent Los Angeles theatres, the Associated Press found that audiences valued meeting and conversation beyond the films, while recovery after the pandemic remained difficult. Read together, these accounts illuminate the proposition behind CyberCon: people can arrive through different interests and decide whether to discover more together. [Near Future Laboratory interview](https://nearfuturelaboratory.com/blog/2024/07/episode-090-kyle-ng/) · [AP on independent cinemas](https://apnews.com/article/hollywood-movie-theaters-quentin-tarantino-cinerama-dome-0347c0912164525998f0c24e6c059878)
